gm.title: Description
lines: A sea spawn master uses parasitic minions to infiltrate coastal communities and draw prey into the water.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: A master releases 3d6 minions near the shore each night until it controls the village. Roughly one in ten reaches shore. A minion paralyzes a host, burrows into its skull, and takes control. Use the Sea Spawn Minion entry for implantation, removal, and daily effects.

gm.title: Coordinated response
lines: The master stays in shallow coastal water and maintains a telepathic link with its brood. If a minion or its host is threatened, it can call on nearby controlled hosts and minions. Use the Sea Spawn Master entry for the submerged confrontation and aquatic allies.

gm.title: Signs and escalation
lines: The minions favor children and infirm people. They abduct others and deliver them to the master. Once the village is under control, the minions drive their own hosts into the sea to feed the master. The occasional survivor matures into a new master after a year.

gm.title: Description

gm.title: Languages

Tentacle (5–6). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and grapples a Medium or smaller creature (escape DC 12). The sea spawn can use that tentacle on another target once the grapple ends.

gm.title: Purple Rocks
lines: In the Forgotten Realms, the kraken Slarkrethel claims the islands' infants and sends them back as followers. In old age they become sea spawn and return to the depths. Some have to hide partial transformations before then. Kraken priests tend the flock.

lines: Any aquatic environment. Solitary. Usually lawful evil. Standard treasure, usually in its underwater lair. Advancement 11–16 HD (Large). No level adjustment or spoken language.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +5. AC −1 size, +1 Dex, +6 natural. Touch 10, flat-footed 15. Base attack +7, grapple +11. Space 5 ft. and reach 10 ft. as printed. Fort +6, Ref +4, Will +9.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Escape Artist +4, Listen +7, Move Silently +10, Search +9, Spot +9, Survival +9. Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Multiattack.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
The master drowns in air as a human does underwater.
Slime (Ex). Its coating works like oil of slipperiness. It also has a printed +10 racial bonus on Escape Artist checks against webs, nets, and similar restraints.
Telepathy (Su). It stays in telepathic contact with its own minions and aquatic allies. If a minion or host is threatened, the master can call on the others nearby.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Claw +11 melee for 1d6 + 4. The attack line omits damage. The full-attack line supplies it.
Full attack. Two claws +11 melee (1d6 + 4 each) and bite +9 melee (2d6 + 2 plus disease).
Disease (Ex). A bitten target makes a DC 18 Fortitude save. On failure, the wound becomes infected immediately. HP lost to infected wounds cannot heal naturally before remove disease or equivalent magic.
Aquatic Allies (Su, 2/day). As summon nature’s ally IV at caster level 10th, limited to aquatic creatures. Summoned creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: A master targeting a coastal community releases 3d6 minions near shore each night until they have taken it over. Roughly one in ten reaches shore. During the day, the master coordinates its minions from a trance in its lair. It sends allies to fight for it and tries to get back into water if forced out.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed space is 5 ft. despite the Large classification. The single-target claw uses damage from the full-attack line.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 10 ft. (2 squares), climb 5 ft., swim 10 ft.

gm.title: Description
lines: A six-inch slug slips ashore and takes over a host so its master can feed on the coastal village.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Any aquatic environment. Brood of 3–18. Always lawful evil. No treasure, advancement or level adjustment.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +9. AC +4 size, +5 Dex. Touch 19, flat-footed 14. Base attack +0, grapple −17. Space 1 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +1, Ref +5, Will +2.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious (Ex). Outside both water and a suitable host it survives 1 hour per point of Constitution (12 hours for this stat block), then uses the drowning rules.
Telepathy (Su). The master that spawned it has a telepathic link to the minion. If the minion or its host is threatened, the master can call other minions or hosts in the area to help.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Bite +0 melee for 1 damage (printed 1d3 − 5, minimum 1) and poison. A DC 11 Fortitude save prevents paralysis for 2d6 minutes. No secondary damage.
Control Host (Ex). As a full-round action, enter a paralyzed victim’s skull. The host makes a DC 16 Will save each round until it fails or the minion is removed. On failure, the minion takes control. The host retains memories, statistics and abilities except divinely granted powers. While implanted, apply a −4 competence penalty to Charisma-based skill checks and 1 Intelligence drain per day. At Intelligence 0, the host dies.
Removal. Cure disease or restoration expels the minion, dealing 3d6 damage to the host as it emerges. Greater restoration destroys it without harming the host.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: A master releases 3d6 minions nightly near shore during an invasion. About one in ten reaches land. Minions climb walls and ceilings and drop onto victims. A typical host is a 1st-level human commoner whose personality becomes detached and distant.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 30 ft. (6 squares), cannot run, swim 60 ft.

gm.title: Description
lines: Packs of drowned sailors lure ships onto the rocks, climb aboard at night, and overwhelm the survivors.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +7. AC 16 (+2 Dex, +2 leather armor, +2 natural), touch 12, flat-footed 14. Base attack +5, grapple +8. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +7, Ref +4, Will +1. Climb +4, Jump +4, Ride +2, Swim +4, Survival +2. Alertness, Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative, Weapon Focus (longsword).

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Slam +8 melee for 1d10 + 3, longsword +9 melee for 1d8 + 3, or shortbow +8 ranged for 1d6.
Disease/Poison (Ex). A creature wounded by the zombie makes an immediate DC 14 Fortitude save against its injury poison. Initial damage is 1d4 Constitution and secondary damage is another 1d4 Constitution. Use the normal secondary poison save.
Stench (Ex). A creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 15 Fortitude save. Failure leaves it nauseated and horrified, with a −1 penalty to attack rolls and AC for 2d4 rounds.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Darkvision 60 ft., damage reduction 5/slashing, spell resistance 10, +2 turn resistance, and undead traits. Electricity and cold deal double damage, and fire deals half damage. Its telepathy reaches other sea zombies within 100 ft.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Shallow waters of Saragoss, the Sea of Sorrows, or Souragne. Packs of 6–10. Always chaotic evil. Standard treasure. They are active at any hour underwater, reach the surface at night, and rarely travel more than 100 ft. inland unless fog covers them.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Use the printed AC despite the listed Dexterity component differing from the ability score. The stench calls its consequence horrified and supplies its duration and numeric penalties. No additional Horror save is specified.

gm.title: Description
lines: Seelie Court fey whose forms vary widely. They use the Seeming to misdirect visitors, trade favors, enforce literal bargains and protect their own.

gm.title: Attacks and defenses
lines: One strike or spell per round. Invisibility at will, plus innate magic and illusions shaped by the individual’s Seeming. Extraordinary Perception and Seeming.
Iron attacks deal +3 damage. Thrown salt blocks invisibility for 1d4 turns.

gm.title: Variant profiles
lines: Faerie Queen · AC 2, MV 15 or fly 15 (B), HD 20, HP 162, THAC0 5, one attack by spell, MR 50%, XP 21,000. Seeming 100. Immune to illusions and charm, invisible at will, knows alignment. Iron deals +2 damage and thrown salt blocks invisibility for one turn.

gm.title: Encounter notes
lines: Deceiver, Innocent, Helper, Protector and Trickster are examples of agendas within the court. Determine what the individual wants before choosing its magic.

gm.title: References
lines: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow, p. 23 · https://www.completecompendium.com/catalog/br/3140/faerseel/

printings.label: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow

gm.title: Description
lines: A creature of the Seeming that takes the shape of what its visitors most dread. Several witnesses might see different creatures in the same place.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Corporeal Shadow World creature. Any size. Chaotic evil.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Rare in the Shadow World. Solitary or in small groups, appearing 1–10. Active any time. Feeds on psychic energy. High intelligence 13–14. Morale 13–14. No treasure, bloodline, blood abilities, or magic resistance.

gm.title: Actions
lines: The seemer senses psychic energy from 500 yards and takes a form before it is seen. It attacks intelligent creatures from outside the Shadow World. An observer must save vs. paralyzation or the seemer automatically gains surprise. It can project one person’s fear to the whole group or show each person a different fear.

gm.title: Form attacks
lines: Use the apparent creature’s movement and attack routines with the seemer’s own AC, HD, and THAC0. Cap each damage roll at 2d6, or use the attack’s normal damage if lower. A spellcasting guise can mimic spell-like attacks other than abjuration or divination. Apparent effects such as poison, aging, and level drain persuade observers they are affected, then wear off after 2d4 hours.

gm.title: Defenses and contact
lines: It takes damage normally despite its disguise. In sunlight it takes −2 to attacks and damage. Shadow World natives with greater Seeming or better can communicate. A creature with extraordinary Seeming has a 5% chance per 10 Seeming points to gain its brief cooperation.

gm.title: Perception and Seeming
lines: Perception slight (1–5), Seeming extraordinary (41+). Compare a viewer’s Perception with the chosen Seeming score to see through the magical guise. Disbelief alone does not end the effect. See pp. 6–8 for the setting procedure.

gm.title: Description
lines: A solitary creature that lives inside illusions and moves between them. Its rumored physical form is that of a small, green-skinned creature with a turnip-shaped head.

gm.title: Attacks
lines: Seeming shards · Throws fragments of a broken illusion. Resolve the effect based on the image created. A deck-of-illusions style effect is one option. The walker uses the distraction to escape.

gm.title: Defenses

gm.title: References

gm.title: Description
lines: Ras Nsi's bodyguard in the Fane of the Night Serpent. Ras Nsi uses him to punish challengers in duels to first blood or death.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Indomitable (2/day). Reroll a failed saving throw.
Magic Resistance. Sekelok has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Innate spellcasting
lines:
Charisma, save DC 13, no material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only), Poison Spray.
3/day. Suggestion.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Greatsword or Shortbow.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. If Sekelok has more than half his maximum hit points left, it deals an extra 7 (2d6) slashing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If Sekelok has more than half his maximum hit points left, it deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Second Wind (recharges after a short or long rest). Regain 20 hit points.

gm.title: Throne room
lines: By day Sekelok guards Ras Nsi in area 11 with three Yuan-ti Broodguards. After Ras Nsi retires to area 12 at night, Sekelok usually stays at his post but sometimes slips away to see Neema in area 10. If the gong in area 9 sounds, he and the other yuan-ti guards investigate while the ghouls stay behind the throne and Ras Nsi withdraws.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Tomb of Annihilation, ch. 4, p. 120 (area 11), using the Champion printed on p. 216 (originally Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 212). The variant changes defenses, senses, languages, and spells. It retains the Champion's 30-ft. speed.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Applied the named source templates to the base creature.

gm.title: Description
lines: Gleam and Glister are high elf acrobats from the Witchlight Carnival. Gleam wears a crescent moon mask and Glister wears a sun mask. Use this profile for either twin, with only her own ray attack.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fey Ancestry. The twin makes saves against being charmed with advantage, and magic cannot put her to sleep.
Regeneration. At the start of her turn, the twin recovers 5 HP if both sisters are alive and within 60 ft. of each other. She dies only if she starts her turn with 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
Twin Bond. While both are alive and on the same plane, each can sense how the other feels.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.
Moon Ray (Gleam only, 3/day). Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) radiant damage. The target makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or becomes a Bat as with Polymorph for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Sun Ray (Glister only, 3/day). Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) radiant damage. The target makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or is blinded for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Twin Sight (recharges after a short or long rest). The twin sees through her sister’s eyes for up to 1 minute while both are alive and on the same plane. The effect requires concentration as on a spell.

gm.title: Motherhorn encounter
lines: Endelyn Moongrave cut off Gleam’s shadow with magic scissors and keeps Glister as a prisoner. When reunited, the twins plan to leave via the Fey Beacons and return to the Witchlight Carnival.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, appendix C, p. 241. Encounter context in ch. 4, Yon.

gm.title: Description
lines: A coastal fey who becomes a seal with the help of a skin bound to them alone. A selkie whose skin is stolen may enlist other selkies to recover it.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: AC 14 in seal form. Perception 14, Stealth 14. Resists cold. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Aquan, Common, and Sylvan.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +0, Wis +2, Cha +3

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fey Resilience. Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed or Unconscious.
Hold Breath. It can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
Speak with Pinnipeds. It can talk with seals, sea lions, and walruses as though they spoke the same language.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. In seal form, make one Bite and two Tail attacks. In Fey form, make three Spear attacks.
Bite (seal form only). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Spear (Fey form only). Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Tail (seal form only). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines:
Change Shape. Magically switch between a Medium seal and its true Fey form. Statistics other than AC, size, and speed carry over, and equipped or carried gear changes with it. A selkie in Fey form must be wearing or carrying its own bound sealskin to use this action. Death restores its Fey form.
Charming Escape. Dash or Disengage. If it Disengages this way, each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or becomes Charmed until the end of the selkie's next turn.

gm.title: Reading Black Flag stat blocks
lines:
Rules source. Black Flag Reference Document, Monsters.
The printed modifiers and fixed HP are ready to use. For a Dexterity (Stealth) check to avoid the creature, use its Perception value as the DC. For a Wisdom (Perception) check to detect it, use its Stealth value as the DC.
Condition resistance gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end the named condition. Condition vulnerability gives disadvantage. Apply damage resistance and vulnerability to the amount of damage instead.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: An unarmored Sensa royal with court robes, a draped mantle, and a longsword.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium Humanoid (human), alignment varies by prince

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Skills Athletics +5, Perception +2. Passive Perception 12. Languages: any one language, usually Common.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Longsword attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

gm.title: Princes and Scorpions
lines:
Prince Kirina and Prince Simbon use this profile when five summoned giant scorpions attack in Anisa. Kirina charges first and Simbon follows. Both fight alongside the characters. A prince at half his hit points or fewer (29 HP with the listed average) takes the Dodge action to avoid further harm.
A DC 16 Intelligence (Nature) check identifies the attackers as twilight dune scorpions. The scorpions vanish when killed. A DC 12 Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) check identifies that as evidence of magical summoning.

gm.title: The rival princes
lines:
Kirina, Prince of Niba, is chaotic evil. He works with High Priest Kedjou to stage a crisis that will make him look like Empress Inaya's strongest heir.
Simbon, Prince of Anisa, is neutral. He takes charge of the Goldwarren rescue at his father's direction and feels obligated to act as a candidate for the throne.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Axiomatic Mind. No effect can force the septon to violate its nature or instructions.
Combat Ready. Roll initiative with advantage.
Disintegration. On death, leave its carried items behind and reduce its body to dust.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make four Tentacle attacks and use either Lightning Network or Spellcasting.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 14). The septon has seven tentacles. Each can hold one target and cannot attack another target while holding a creature.
Lightning Network. Electricity fills a 30-ft. cube originating at the septon and disperses immediately. Each creature in the cube makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 33 (6d10) lightning damage and is stunned for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half damage only. The stunned target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +11 and Con +11. Athletics +11. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Immune to poison and psychic damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 9. Understands Dwarvish and cannot speak.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Immutable Form. Powers, spells, and other effects cannot change its form.
Siege Monster. It deals double damage to structures and objects.
Supernatural Resistance. It has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Wrecking Ball and Stone. It can also use Lay the Foundation if available.

Stone. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit falls Prone.
Lay the Foundation (recharge 6). Cover a 20-ft. square of ground with wet concrete starting from a point within 5 ft. The area is difficult terrain for 1 hour as the concrete dries. A creature with Strength 20 or less that starts its turn there must pass a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check or be Restrained until the start of its next turn.

gm.title: Mundane Attacks (MCDM)
lines: For these resistances, a mundane attack uses neither magic nor psionics.

gm.title: Traits

Supernatural Resistance. It has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
Tunneler. It can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed, leaving a tunnel 5 ft. in diameter.

gm.title: Actions

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: Description
lines: This cloaker moves like a patch of darkness, then latches onto a lone traveler’s shadow and feeds through their touch.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +7. AC components −1 size, +3 Dex, +7 natural. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 16. Base attack +4. Space 10 ft., reach 10 ft. (5 ft. with bite). Fort +9, Ref +5, Will +7. Standard treasure.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Tail slap +8 melee (1d6 + 5).
Full attack. Tail slap +8 melee (1d6 + 5) and bite +3 melee (1d4 + 2). It can use the tail on another target while engulfing and can use the tail while attached.
Attach (Su). On a bite that hits a human-shaped living creature at least one size smaller, attach to its shadow. It cannot bite while attached. This ends when either dies or when a daylight, sunbeam, or sunburst spell targets the cloaker. Without a host it loses 1 HD per week, recovering 1 HD per day of feeding through a new host.
Constitution Drain (Su). The cloaker feeds once per day. Its host’s contact with a living creature deals 1 point of Constitution drain to that creature 2d8 minutes later. Against an unwilling creature, the host must make a touch attack. If the host touches no living creature for 24 hours, the cloaker feeds from the host. A creature drained to Constitution 0 dies and rises as a shadow 24 hours later.
Shadow Shift (Su). The cloaker and its host gain concealment (20% miss chance) for 1d4 rounds.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Hide +12, Listen +11, Move Silently +12, Spot +11. In shadowy areas it gains a +5 racial bonus on Hide checks (total +17), and a host also gains that +5 racial bonus. A successful Move Silently check lets the cloaker gain surprise when it attacks. Feats: Alertness, Improved Initiative.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Underground. Solitary. Always chaotic neutral. Advancement 7–9 HD (Large), 10–18 HD (Huge).

gm.title: Shared dread cloaker rules
lines:
Printed source. Cloaker, Dread, p. 51.
Damage reduction (Su). A cloaker draped around its host shares its damage reduction against physical attacks other than area attacks.
Engulf (Ex). As a standard action, the cloaker envelops a creature at least one size category smaller. Its host is engulfed automatically. Any other target requires a successful grapple check without provoking an attack of opportunity. The target is pinned. A cloaker without a host gains +4 to bite the engulfed creature.
Split damage from attacks that hit an engulfing cloaker equally between it and its victim. Area spells deal full damage to both. A shadow or undead cloaker can still strike other targets with its tail while engulfing a creature.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The stat block gives both 6d8 + 18 and 34 HP. Use its listed HP for the printed specimen. The Base Attack/Grapple row gives +4 alone.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dragon twisted by shadow magic. Its presence dims lights and weakens healing near its lair.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). After failing a save, the creature can spend a use to succeed instead.
Living Shadow. While in Dim Light or Darkness, the dragon resists damage other than Force, Psychic, and Radiant.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the dragon makes ability checks and attack rolls with Disadvantage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage and 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.
Shadow Breath (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 60-ft. Cone makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. On a failure the creature takes 35 (10d6) Necrotic damage. On a success it takes half damage. A Humanoid this damage reduces to 0 HP dies and a Shadow rises from its corpse. The dragon controls the Shadow. The Shadow shares its Initiative count and acts immediately after it.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Shadow Stealth. Take the Hide action while in Dim Light or Darkness.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 uses, or 4 in its lair. Spend one use just after another creature's turn ends. All uses return at the start of the creature's turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make one Rend attack.
Veil of Shadow. Use Shadow Stealth. Choose one creature the dragon can see within 10 ft. It takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. This option is then unavailable until the start of the dragon's next turn.

gm.title: In its lair
lines: 11,500 XP. Legendary Resistance increases to 4/day and Legendary Actions increase to 4 uses.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Negative Energy Suffusion. Within 1 mile of the lair, subtract 1d10 from the HP a creature regains from a spell.
Stifling Shadows. Within 1 mile of the lair, effects that would create Bright Light create Dim Light. Creatures in that area make Dexterity (Stealth) checks with Advantage.
Both effects end immediately if the dragon dies or moves its lair.

lines: A winged demon fights from darkness. It tries to disarm anyone carrying a lantern or torch, then charges from cover.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Any land or underground. Solitary. Always chaotic evil. No treasure. Advancement 8–12 HD (Medium) or 13–20 HD (Large). Level adjustment +7. Requires no sustenance.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +6. AC 13 (+2 Dex, +1 natural), touch 13 as printed, flat-footed 11. Base attack +7, grapple +8. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +6, Ref +7, Will +7.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Bluff +8, Concentration +8, Hide +8 (add +10 racial in low light or darkness), Intimidate +10, Jump +10, Listen +13, Move Silently +10, Sense Motive +7, Spot +9. Alertness, Improved Initiative.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Blindsight, damage reduction 5/silver, immunity to poison and electricity, resistance 10 to acid, cold, and fire, and tanar’ri traits. Telepathy (Su). 100 ft. with any creature that has a language.
Shadow Armor (Su). Add +4 deflection AC in dim light such as torchlight or moonlight. Add +8 instead in total darkness.
Sensitivity to Light (Ex). In bright sunlight or daylight, it takes −2 on attacks. A hit against it that threatens a critical hit automatically confirms.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Claw +8 melee (1d6 + 1). Full attack. Two claws +8 melee each (1d6 + 1), plus bite +3 melee (1d8).
Pounce (Ex). On a charge, make a full attack with four rake attacks. Each rake is +8 melee (1d6 + 1).
Spell-like abilities. Caster level 10th, save DC 12 + spell level. Darkness and cause fear at will. Magic jar once per week.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed touch AC is 13 despite the listed +1 natural armor. Blindsight has no printed range. Set the range at the table if needed.

gm.title: Description
lines: A nightmare that moves through solid objects and slips between shadows. The Rakdos sometimes bring one onstage.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Incorporeal Movement. The horror treats creatures and objects as difficult terrain when moving through them. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the horror has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Shadow Stealth. The horror can Hide while in dim light or darkness.
Shadow Stride. Step into a shadow within 5 ft. and magically appear in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of a second shadow up to 60 ft. away. Each shadow must come from a Small or larger creature or object.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage, and the target must make a DC 16 Wisdom save or become frightened of the horror until the end of the target’s next turn.
Lashing Shadows (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 60 ft. except other horrors must make a DC 16 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 27 (6d8) necrotic damage.

gm.title: Optional primary features
lines:
Choose or roll one primary and one secondary feature using the d4 tables on p. 204. Add them to the base stat block.
1. Avoidance. If an effect allows a save for half damage, a success instead deals no damage and a failure deals half.
2. Damage Resistances. The horror gains resistance to necrotic and psychic damage.
3. Innate Spellcasting. With Charisma and spell save DC 16, it can cast Darkness 3/day and Fear 1/day without material components.
4. Psychic Rebuke. When a melee attack damages the horror, it can use its reaction to deal 7 (2d6) psychic damage to each creature within 5 ft.

gm.title: Optional secondary features
lines:
1. Grasping Tendrils. The horror has four tendrils, each with AC 12 and 10 HP. Destroying a tendril does not harm the horror. As a bonus action, it can target a visible creature within 10 ft. The target must make a DC 13 Dexterity save or be grappled (escape DC 13). A tendril can hold only one target at a time.
2. Indomitable Mind. The horror becomes immune to being charmed.
3. Keen Senses. It gains advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, sound, or smell.
4. Mind Sight. Magical darkness does not impede its darkvision.

gm.title: Optional madness
lines: If you use the optional madness rule on p. 203, record each time a character fails the save against Claw. See Flying Horror for the shared end-of-encounter save and severity table.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 205. Optional horror rules on pp. 203–204.

Lullaby (Su). As a standard action, opponents within 20 ft. must make a DC 14 Will save. Failure fatigues them for 1d4 rounds or as long as the dream spawn keeps speaking within 20 ft. of them. Maintaining the lullaby is a free action. This is a sonic, mind-affecting compulsion.
Memory Drain (Su, 1/day). A successful touch attack deals 1d4 Intelligence damage. Until the victim recovers all of those points, the dream spawn can use Alternate Form to impersonate any creature from the victim's memory.
Alternate Form (Su). Use polymorph on itself as a standard action at caster level 8. The form can last indefinitely. Returning to its own shape is a free action.
Nightmare Howl (Su). As a standard action, opponents within 60 ft. make a DC 14 Will save. Failure paralyzes the creature with fear for 1d4 rounds and heals the shadow morph for 1d4 HP per failed save. Anyone exposed is immune to that morph's howl for 1 day. All dream spawn are immune. This is a sonic, mind-affecting fear effect.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 10/magic. Darkvision 60 ft. It does not need to eat, drink, or breathe. Detect Thoughts (Su). In an inhabited dreamscape, it knows a creature's surface thoughts as though it had studied them for three rounds with detect thoughts, caster level 5, Will DC 14. Fear Eater (Ex). Immune to Fear, Horror, and Madness. A spell targeting it that would normally cause one of those effects heals 1 HP per spell level. When one of its actions makes a dreamer fail a Fear, Horror, or Madness save, it heals 2 HP for a minor outcome, 4 HP for a moderate outcome, or 8 HP for a major outcome.

gm.title: Dream defeat
lines: A dreamer killed by this dream spawn takes a DC 14 Ravenloft Madness save on waking (Will). For consequences and recovery, use the Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, chapter 3. A spawn that wins often returns to terrorize that dreamer again.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Bluff +10, Disguise +10, Hide +4, Intimidate +5, Listen +5, Move Silently +4, Sense Motive +8, Spot +5. Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Disguise). Speaks Oneiros and the languages of its current prey.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land or underground (dreams). Solitary, pair, or pack of 3–6. No treasure. Always lawful evil. Advances at 6–10 HD (Medium) or 11–15 HD (Large). It uses familiar forms to lure dreamers close before it attacks.

gm.title: Description
lines: A black garment adapts to its wearer and trades powers for experience. If starved or threatened with death, it may take the wearer into the Plane of Shadows.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Tiny item or Medium shadow creature

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Very rare, appearing 1d4. Neutral. Intelligence 11–12. No treasure or magic resistance. Immune to the Red Curse.

gm.title: Actions
lines: On the Prime Material Plane, the worn form has AC 10, 1 HD, THAC0 19, no movement or attacks, steady morale 11–12 and an XP value of 120. No magical aura betrays it. On the Plane of Shadows it becomes a humanoid with AC 2, 8 HD, THAC0 13, movement 15, champion morale 15–16 and an XP value of 5,000. It attacks twice for 2d4 each. Each hit drains 10% of the experience needed for a level and 1 point of Strength or Constitution, chosen at equal odds.

gm.title: Mask
lines: The wearer concentrates to gain immunity to mind-affecting magic, at 20 XP per use per wearer level. In the Plane of Shadows the symbiont has that immunity itself.

gm.title: Cloak
lines: Absorbs all magical HP damage from a hit that would reduce the wearer below 0 HP. Costs 10 XP per point absorbed per wearer level. In the Plane of Shadows, subtract 8 points of damage from each attack against the symbiont.

gm.title: Gloves
lines: Give the wearer the Luck Legacy for hand-related actions only, allowing a reroll of a failed save or ability check when applicable. Costs 20 XP per use per wearer level. In the Plane of Shadows, the symbiont itself has Luck.

gm.title: Boots
lines: Allow the wearer to cast dimension door for 10 XP per use per wearer level. The boots can also guide the wearer toward opportunities to earn XP at no cost, without controlling decisions. In the Plane of Shadows they cast dimension door as an 8th-level mage once per round.

gm.title: Feeding and defense
lines: Only spells and weapons of +1 or better can harm the symbiont. Any damage it suffers also harms the wearer. A lethal attempt makes it flee by plane shift with the wearer. A wearer who gains too little new XP to feed it saves vs. spell. Success makes it drain three times the missing XP before slipping away. On failure it takes the wearer to the Plane of Shadows and tries to devour them.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: pp. 108–109, with Luck Legacy on p. 8

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The encounter gives each power’s XP cost and describes the consequences of shortfalls, without prescribing a separate feeding schedule.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dark-coated unicorn slips through shadowed woodland, then breaks cover with a flaming horn and a scream.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Temperate forests of Darkon, Falkovnia, and the Phantasmal Forest. Solitary or pair. Always neutral evil. No treasure. Advancement 6–10 HD (Large). No level adjustment listed. Speaks Sylvan, Infernal, and Abyssal.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +8 as printed. AC −1 size, +4 Dex, +8 natural, touch 13, flat-footed 17. Base attack +5, grapple +17. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. or 10 ft. with the horn. Fort +8, Ref +8, Will +3.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Hide +6, Jump +6, Listen +5, Move Silently +10, Spot +6, Survival +7. Alertness, Multiattack.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Damage reduction 5/magic. Immune to charm-related spells, poisons, and the fire from its own horn. Shadow Merge (Su). In shadowy areas, gain total concealment and move without sound. It can suppress the effect.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Horn +13 melee (1d8 + 12, plus 1d4 fire when aflame). As an alternative full attack, make two hoof attacks +13 melee each (1d4 + 4), and one bite +11 melee (1d8 + 4).
Flaming Horn (Su). Ignite the horn as a free action. A hit with it adds 1d4 fire damage and ignites combustibles.
Blink (Sp, 3/day). Caster level 8th. Use only in shadowy areas.
Terror Scream (Su). Functions as fear at caster level 8th, DC 20. A failed Ravenloft Fear save that produces a major effect also permanently turns the victim’s hair white.

gm.title: Ravenloft Fear
lines: When using the Ravenloft Fear rules, roll a Will save. Apply modifiers to saves against fear. Failure by 1–5 makes the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11–15 panicked. Failure by 16 or more makes it panicked and calls for an immediate Horror save at the Fear DC minus 5. Fear lasts 5d6 rounds. A second failure escalates shaken to frightened or frightened to panicked. Creatures without Intelligence scores are immune. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, pp. 77–79.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Initiative +8 and 45 hp are printed values. The initiative includes an unexplained +4 above the Dex modifier.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Lightning Absorption. When subjected to lightning damage, the mound regains hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Charged Tendril attacks. The mound can replace one of those attacks with Engulf.
Charged Tendril. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) lightning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the mound pulls it 5 ft. straight toward itself.
Engulf. Choose one Medium or smaller creature within 5 ft. The target makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, the mound pulls it into its space and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14). gm.title: Origins and appearance (1d6)
lines: 1. Covered in alien flowers or Feywild blooms. 2. Carrying a rune-covered standing stone in its torso. 3. Hosting vermin or fungi. 4. A knot of vines around skeletons. 5. Mutated and leaking glowing waste. 6. The remains of an ancient tree or Treant.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A huge mass of roots, reeds and swamp vines with lashing tendrils and an interwoven sack for prey.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Constitution save +8. Poison damage immunity. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Flanked, Frightened, Poisoned and Prone. Blindsight 120 ft., blind beyond that range. Passive Perception 10. No languages.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Engulfing Sack. The mound’s sack can be targeted separately. It has AC 15, 50 HP, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Damage to the sack does not hurt the mound. Destroying the sack frees all engulfed creatures. The mound regrows the sack at the start of its next turn.
False Appearance. While motionless, the mound looks like an ordinary mass of vegetation.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Vine Lash attacks. The mound may replace one of them with Engulf when it is available.
Vine Lash. Melee or ranged weapon attack +8, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage. The mound can pull a Medium or smaller target up to 30 ft. toward it.
Engulf (Recharge 5–6). Choose up to two Medium or smaller creatures within 30 ft. Each makes a DC 16 Strength save or is drawn into the sack. An engulfed creature is Restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects outside the mound, and takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of the mound’s turns. It moves with the mound. If the mound dies or the sack is destroyed, each engulfed creature is freed into an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 ft. of the mound.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Poison Froth. When the mound takes damage, each creature in the sack takes 3 (1d6) poison damage. The mound regains HP equal to the total damage this reaction deals to the engulfed creatures.

gm.title: Hit point rule
lines: 7 + 7 × the caregiver’s level in hit points, with one d8 Hit Die per caregiver level.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A compact, fern-covered mound with two lashing vines and a woven pocket that can hold prey.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Armor class 13 + PB. Constitution save +2 + PB. Skills Athletics +3 + PB and Perception +PB. Poison damage immunity. Immune to Blinded and Poisoned. Blindsight 60 ft., blind beyond that range. Passive Perception 10 + PB.

gm.title: Caregiver scaling
lines: PB is the caregiver’s proficiency bonus.

gm.title: Traits
lines: False Appearance. A motionless mound looks like ordinary vegetation. A caregiver of Large size or smaller can take the Hide action to try to hide in its space while it remains still.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Signature Attack (Vine Lash). Melee weapon attack at +3 + PB, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1d6 + PB piercing damage.

gm.title: Ferocity actions
lines:
Level 1, Long-Range Lash (2 Ferocity). Make a signature attack at 30-ft. reach. On a hit against a Medium or smaller creature, the mound can pull it up to 10 ft.
Level 3, Verdant Roundup (5 Ferocity). Choose up to PB Large or smaller creatures within 30 ft. Each makes a Dexterity save against DC 10 + PB. On a failure, the target is pulled up to 15 ft. toward the mound and takes PBd4 poison damage.
Level 5, Engulf (8 Ferocity). One Large or smaller creature within 5 ft. makes a Strength save against DC 10 + PB. A failure pulls it into the mound’s space, deals PBd8 poison damage and engulfs it. A success deals half damage and leaves it in place. While engulfed it moves with the mound, is Restrained, has total cover from outside effects and takes PBd8 poison damage at the start of each of the mound’s turns. It can spend an action on a Strength check against DC 10 + PB to escape into a free space of its choice within 5 ft. The mound can hold one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures.

gm.title: Mystic connection
lines: Maw of the Mound. At 9th level, a Beastheart with this companion and Mystic Connection can use a bonus action to bite an enemy with an unarmed strike. Use Strength or Dexterity to hit and for damage. A hit deals 1d6 plus the chosen modifier in piercing damage and grants temporary HP equal to the damage dealt. Uses equal PB and refresh on a long rest.

gm.title: MCDM companion rules
lines:
Shared turn. The caregiver and companion act on the same turn. The companion moves and uses its reaction and bonus action independently. To do anything with its action besides Dash, Disengage or Dodge, it normally needs a command that costs the caregiver a bonus action. It must see or hear the caregiver. If the caregiver is Incapacitated, it can act without a command. The GM chooses who controls it when the caregiver is Incapacitated or absent.
Ferocity. At the start of their turn, unless Incapacitated, the companion gains 1d4 Ferocity plus one for each enemy it sees or hears within 5 ft. A swarm sharing one stat block counts as one enemy. Spend the listed cost before taking a Ferocity action. It uses the companion’s action, requires the listed caregiver level and is unavailable during a rampage.
Rampage. After rolling Ferocity, a companion with at least 10 Ferocity risks a rampage if it is not Incapacitated. A caregiver who is not Incapacitated and can be seen or heard can prevent it with a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check against DC 5 + Ferocity, without spending an action. If the companion rampages, it immediately moves toward the nearest creature it senses and makes its signature attack, with extra damage equal to half its Ferocity on a hit. If an ally and enemy tie for nearest, roll any die. On an odd roll the caregiver’s player chooses a tied ally. On an even roll they choose a tied enemy. If it cannot reach a target, it Dashes toward it. If it senses none, it moves as far as it can in a random safe direction. Ferocity falls to 0 after this action or at the end of the turn.
Recovery. At 0 HP, a companion makes death saves. After combat, Ferocity resets to 0. A companion that is not dying first regains HP equal to its remaining Ferocity.

lines: A low heap of wet leaves, roots and grabbing fronds, smaller than a full-grown shambling mound.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Poison damage immunity. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Flanked, Frightened, Poisoned and Prone. Blindsight 60 ft., blind beyond that range. Passive Perception 10. No languages.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
False Appearance. A motionless pile passes for an ordinary heap of vegetation.
Hungry Grab. An enemy starting its turn within 5 ft. of at least three piles makes a Dexterity save or is Grappled. While grappled this way, it is Restrained and takes poison damage at the start of each of its turns equal to the number of piles within 5 ft. of it. The save and escape DC are 10 plus that number. The grapple ends if fewer than three piles remain within 5 ft.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed saving throw drops the pile to 0 HP. It ignores other damage below 12 and dies if such an effect deals at least 12 damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Vine Lash (Group Attack). Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 piercing damage.

gm.title: Minion rules
lines:
Group attack. Two to five piles on the same turn can each spend an action to lash one target within reach of all of them. Make a single attack at +6 plus the number joining. A hit deals 4 piercing damage per pile. A solo pile attacks at +6. If all participants have advantage or disadvantage, so does the roll. Separate groups when cover or concealment differs. The target chooses one attacker for a response that can only affect one.
Group opportunity attack. If the target provokes from multiple piles at once, each can spend its reaction to join. Piles have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. After a weapon attack exceeds a pile’s 12 HP, each additional 12 points of damage or part of 12 can drop another eligible pile to 0 HP. For melee, each additional pile must be within the weapon’s reach. For ranged, it must be on the line from attacker through the original target and within the weapon’s short range. This rule does not apply to opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Description
lines: A hulking, fungus-covered demodand that claims the right to police Carceri and commands those beneath it.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A winged jailer fiend with a heavy body, wet hide, and an enervating trident.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Abyssal, Common, Demodand, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, and restrained.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Boundless Movement. Ignore difficult terrain and magical reductions to speed. Spend 5 ft. of movement to end the grappled condition on the shator automatically.
Jailer (1/day). Cast Imprisonment using Intelligence (save DC 18), without material components. The spell can use only the chaining option.
Liquefaction Ritual. Spend 1 minute to turn any number of willing Farastu Demodands and Kelubar Demodands within 60 ft. into living liquid. Each fits into a flask. Each is paralyzed despite immunity to that condition, takes no damage, and has any curses on it suspended. A shator can end the effect as an action, and opening a container also restores the demodand inside.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Numbing Secretions. A creature that touches the shator or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft. must make a DC 17 Dexterity save. A failure halves the creature’s speed and gives it disadvantage on attack rolls through the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Enervating Trident attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (3d6 + 7) piercing plus 26 (4d12) acid damage. A creature hit must make a DC 16 Constitution save or be paralyzed until the start of the shator’s next turn.
Enervating Trident. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (2d10 + 7) necrotic damage.
Inhibitory Spray (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 100-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 40 (9d8) acid damage and is paralyzed for 1 minute. A success halves the damage and avoids paralysis. A paralyzed creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the paralysis on a success.
Summon Demodand (1/day). Choose one group to summon: 1d4 Farastu Demodands, 1d2 Kelubar Demodands, or one Shator Demodand. The attempt has a 50 percent chance of success. Each appears in a free space within 60 ft., acts as the shator’s ally, and cannot summon another demodand. Each stays for 1 minute unless it or the summoner dies, or the shator dismisses it with an action.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:

At will. Invisibility (self only), Suggestion.
1/day each. Dispel Magic, Plane Shift (Carceri only), Scrying (casting time of one action).

gm.title: Description
lines: A red-furred arcanaloth who runs Fortune’s Wheel. She uses her casino in Sigil to collect secrets, influence rivals, and trade in favors across the planes.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A foxlike arcanaloth dressed as a wealthy Sigil crime boss.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold, fire, and lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (4/day). Shemeshka can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Special Equipment. In someone else’s hands, her Razorvine Tiara works as a Tentacle Rod that deals slashing damage in place of bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Use Arcane Flux or Spellcasting, then make one Claw or Razorvine Tiara attack.
Arcane Flux. Choose a visible creature within 120 ft. It makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 45 (7d12) force damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage only.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.
Razorvine Tiara. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (3d6) slashing plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. A creature hit makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, its speed is halved and it has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws through the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, or as part of Multiattack, cast one spell below using Intelligence (save DC 18), with no material components.
At will. Alter Self, Darkness, Invisibility (self only), Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
2/day each. Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Suggestion.
1/day each. Banishment, Contact Other Plane (casting time of one action), Mind Blank.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Teleport. Move Shemeshka and her worn or carried gear up to 60 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Fell Counterspell (3/day). React when Shemeshka sees a creature casting a spell. A spell of 5th level or lower fails. For a higher-level spell, Shemeshka makes an Intelligence check with DC 10 + the spell’s level. The spell fails if she succeeds. Regardless of whether the spell fails, its caster is poisoned until the end of the caster’s next turn.

gm.title: House of Liars (adventure encounter)
lines:
Turn of Fortune’s Wheel, chapter 14, area P6a. An invisible Eater of Knowledge that has consumed five brains and an invisible Maelephant attack at Shemeshka’s call. She relies on defensive spells, Teleport, Fell Counterspell, and the area defenses. Once both guards fall, she offers a truce and escapes with an Amulet of the Planes after sharing what she knows, or if fighting resumes after that disclosure.
With Shemeshka present in a fight in P6, roll 1d4 at initiative count 0 each round. Choose which creatures in the area each result affects.
1. Wind fills the area for 1 round. Chosen creatures make a DC 18 Wisdom save or gain one level of exhaustion.
2. Chosen creatures touching the floor make a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a failure, a creature takes 22 (4d10) slashing damage and is restrained through the end of the next round. Success halves the damage and avoids restraint.
3. Chosen creatures make a DC 18 Wisdom save or suffer the effects of Confusion.
4. Chosen creatures make a DC 18 Wisdom save. Failure deals 27 (5d10) psychic damage and gives disadvantage on their next attack roll or save before initiative count 0 next round. Success halves the damage only.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Bound. The shield guardian is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet’s wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet’s wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian. Regeneration. The shield guardian regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. Spell Storing. A spellcaster who wears the shield guardian’s amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of 4th level or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. When commanded to do so by the wearer or when a situation arises that was predefined by the spellcaster, the guardian casts the stored spell with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no components. When the spell is cast or a new spell is stored, any previously stored spell is lost.

lines: A construct protects whoever wears its matching amulet and can release a stored spell when needed.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Bound. While the guardian and amulet are on the same plane, the wearer can telepathically call the guardian to come to the amulet. The guardian knows the direction and distance to it. If the guardian is within 60 ft. of the wearer, it takes half of any damage dealt to the wearer, rounded up, in the wearer’s place.
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, it regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
Constructed Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Master’s amulet
lines: The guardian has one linked amulet. The wearer can order it to attack or guard. Destroying the amulet Incapacitates the guardian until a replacement is made. An amulet can be targeted directly if nobody is wearing or carrying it. It has AC 10, 10 HP, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Making a replacement takes 1 week and costs 1,000 gp in components.

gm.title: Spell Storing
lines: A spellcaster wearing the amulet can cast a spell of 4th level or lower on the guardian. The spell is stored without taking effect. The guardian casts it when the wearer orders it to, or when a condition set by the caster occurs. The original caster sets the spell’s parameters, and the guardian needs no components. Casting empties the store. Storing a new spell replaces the previous one.

gm.title: Actions

Fist. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Shield. When a creature attacks the amulet wearer, the guardian can give the wearer +2 AC against that attack if the guardian is within 5 ft. of the wearer.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Its Multiattack is two fists. With its amulet wearer within 60 feet, it takes half the damage the wearer would take. It also has a reaction to add 2 AC for the nearby wearer, regeneration, and a stored spell.

gm.title: Reading Black Flag stat blocks
lines:
Rules source. Black Flag Reference Document, Monsters.
The printed modifiers and fixed HP are ready to use. For a Dexterity (Stealth) check to avoid the creature, use its Perception value as the DC. For a Wisdom (Perception) check to detect it, use its Stealth value as the DC.
Condition resistance gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end the named condition. Condition vulnerability gives disadvantage. Apply damage resistance and vulnerability to the amount of damage instead.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saves Str +5 and Con +5. Perception +2, Survival +2. Resists fire. Tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 12. No languages.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Tunneler. Burrow through solid rock at half burrow speed. The burrow leaves a 3-ft.-diameter tunnel for 10 minutes before it collapses. Tiny and Small creatures fit through normally. Medium and Large creatures can squeeze through.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Fiery Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing plus 3 (1d6) fire.
Erupt (1/day). While burrowing within 10 ft. of the surface, emerge into a space with at least one creature without spending movement. Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. A creature directly above the emergence rolls with disadvantage. On failure, take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning and fall Prone. On success, take half damage and get pushed 5 ft. into an unoccupied space of the creature’s choice.
Wrecking Ball (1/day). Move in a straight line up to twice walking speed without provoking opportunity attacks, passing through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space is entered makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) fire. A structure or an object that is neither worn nor carried takes twice that damage if the drangolin enters its space.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Ash Shot. When a creature the drangolin can sense moves within 5 ft., force a DC 13 Dexterity save. On failure, the creature is Blinded until the start of its next turn.

lines: An iridescent ooze that changes color after absorbing a damaging spell.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Adaptive determines its damage immunity. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Prone. Blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 8. No languages.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amorphous. Move through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces, including walls and ceilings, without a check.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) acid damage and grapple the target (escape DC 13). The target is Restrained until the grapple ends. The slime cannot use Pseudopod on another target while the grapple lasts.
Swallow. Make a Pseudopod attack against a grappled target at least one size smaller than the slime. On a hit, the grapple ends and the target is swallowed. A swallowed target is Restrained and has total cover against attacks and effects from outside the slime. At the start of each of the target’s turns it makes a DC 13 Constitution save, taking 3 (1d6) acid damage on a failure. If Adaptive gives the slime damage immunity, use that damage type instead. The slime can keep one creature swallowed. If the slime dies, the target is free to move and is no longer Restrained.

gm.title: Reactions
lines:
Split. If a hit deals slashing damage while the slime is Medium or larger and has at least 10 HP, it divides into two slimes. Each is one size smaller and has half the original’s HP, rounded down. Both new slimes retain Adaptive and inherit the parent’s current immunity.
Adaptive. When hit by a damaging spell, the slime can gain immunity to that damage type for 1 hour. A new immunity replaces the existing one and changes the slime’s color.

gm.title: Description
lines: A mountain hag whose hut walks on cat paws. She fights alone and can turn into a cat to escape a failed save.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saving throw Wis +5. Deception +7, Perception +5, Stealth +6, Survival +5. Resists thunder and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to cold, fire, Charmed, and Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Common, Giant, Infernal, Sylvan.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Feline Resilience (3/day). When Nonna fails a save, she can turn into a cat and succeed instead. The cat is Medium, or Large during Grow. She keeps her statistics and can speak, but cannot cast spells or use Soul Steal. She returns to her previous form at the end of her next turn.
Supernatural Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Corrosive Claw attacks. One can be replaced with Soul Steal if available.
Corrosive Claw. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft. or 10 ft. with Grow, one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, or 14 (3d6 + 4) with Grow. If the target wears mundane metal armor it makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure the armor permanently loses 1 AC, cumulative across hits. The armor is destroyed if its AC falls to 10.
Soul Steal (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 16 (3d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Nonna regains 10 HP per failed save.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines:
Grow (2/day, 3rd-level spell). For 1 minute Nonna and her gear grow to Large or the largest size the space permits. Her reach becomes 10 ft., her Strength-based weapon attacks deal an extra 3 (1d6) damage already included above, and she has advantage on Strength checks and saves.
Gobble You Up. An Unconscious creature within 5 ft. takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage and Soul Steal recharges.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Turned Upside Down. When a creature hits Nonna with a melee attack, each creature within 5 ft. of her makes a DC 15 Strength save. On failure it rises vertically 10 ft. and hangs there until the end of its next turn. It then falls unless it can stay aloft.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Use each villain action once per encounter after an enemy's turn. Use at most one per round, in any order.
Action 1, Snackies for Sweeties. Each other creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is Poisoned for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of its turns. Holding its breath or needing no air gives no protection.
Action 2, Feline Felicity. Each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On failure it takes 10 (4d4) force damage and is pushed 10 ft. away. A success halves damage and prevents the push. Nonna can then move up to twice her speed.
Action 3, Open the Oven. Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. It takes 13 (3d8) fire plus 13 (3d8) thunder damage on failure or half on success.

gm.title: Utility Spells
lines: Charisma, save DC 15. At will, 1 action each: Alter Self, Detect Thoughts, Thaumaturgy. 3/day each, longer casting times: Fabricate, Legend Lore. 1/day: Scrying using its longer casting time.

gm.title: Mundane Attacks (MCDM)
lines: A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.

lines: The printed Corrosive Claw calls for a 'Dexterity throw.' Use a Dexterity saving throw, as the DC and attack context indicate.

gm.title: Description
lines: Sibriexes collect ancient knowledge in remote parts of the Abyss. Demon lords seek their advice, and those who want their bodies reshaped must offer treasure or a service in return.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold, fire, lightning. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Contamination. Vegetation withers within 30 ft. of the sibriex, and the ground there is difficult terrain for other creatures. Any creature that starts its turn in the aura must pass a DC 20 Constitution save or take 14 (4d6) poison damage. A creature that passes the save is immune to this sibriex's Contamination for 24 hours.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The sibriex can spend one use to succeed on a saving throw it failed.
Magic Resistance. The sibriex has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Chain attacks and use Squirt Bile.
Chain. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d12 + 7) force damage.
Squirt Bile. Choose one creature the sibriex can see within 120 ft. It must pass a DC 20 Dexterity save or take 31 (9d6) acid damage.
Warp Creature. Choose up to three creatures the sibriex can see within 120 ft. Each makes a DC 20 Constitution save. A creature that passes this initial save is immune to this sibriex's Warp Creature. A creature that fails is poisoned and gains one level of exhaustion. While poisoned this way, the target repeats the save at the start of each of its turns. Each failure adds one level of exhaustion. Three successful saves end the poison. When this poison ends, remove all exhaustion it caused. A target that reaches six levels of exhaustion dies and immediately becomes a living manes under the sibriex's control. Only Wish can undo the body's transformation.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast a listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 21), without material components.
At will. Command, Dispel Magic, Hold Monster.
1/day. Feeblemind.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The sibriex has three legendary actions and recovers them at the start of its turn. It can use one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn. It cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using one.
Cast a Spell (1 action). Use Spellcasting.
Spray Bile (1 action). Use Squirt Bile.
Warp (2 actions). Use Warp Creature.

gm.title: Flesh warping mechanics
lines:
Optional rule. When a creature fails a save against Warp Creature, you can roll d100 for an extra effect. It ends when Warp Creature ends on that creature. If the creature becomes a manes, the effect stays with that body permanently. A willing creature can stay within 30 ft. of the sibriex and undergo at least 1 hour of painful warping. At the end, roll once or choose one effect. This change is permanent.
01–05. Hair, eyes, and skin change to blue, red, yellow, or a pattern.
06–10. The eyes extend on stalks.
11–15. Hands grow claws that can be used as daggers.
16–20. One leg lengthens, reducing walking speed by 10 ft.
21–25. Open eyes give off a 15-ft. cone of dim light.
26–30. Feathery or leathery wings grow from the back and give a flying speed of 30 ft.
31–35. The ears detach and scamper away. The creature is deafened.
36–40. Two teeth change into short tusks.
41–45. Barklike scales give +1 AC and reduce Charisma by 2, to a minimum of 1.
46–50. Arms and legs trade places. The creature moves only by crawling.
51–55. Arms become finger-tipped tentacles, increasing reach by 5 ft.
56–60. Long, springy legs increase walking speed by 10 ft.
61–65. A long, thin tail grows and can be used as a whip.
66–70. The eyes turn black and grant darkvision to 120 ft.
71–75. The body swells to three times its weight.
76–80. The body grows skeletal and weighs half as much.
81–85. The head grows to three times its size.
86–90. Wings replace the ears and give a flying speed of 5 ft.
91–95. The brittle body becomes vulnerable to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
96–00. Another head grows, giving advantage on saves against being charmed, frightened, or stunned.

gm.title: Description
lines: The silver variant breathes cold. Its other breath can put enemies to sleep or leave them off balance.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Metallic Awakening (recharges after a short or long rest). When the creature would drop to 0 HP, set its current HP to 450, recharge Breath Weapon, and restore all spent uses of Legendary Resistance. The creature can take mythic actions for the following hour. Award 120,000 extra XP if defeated after this trait activates (240,000 XP total).
Legendary Resistance (4/day). Turn a failed save into a success.
Unusual Nature. The greatwyrm needs no food or drink.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) force damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d8 + 10) slashing damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 20) and restrained until the grapple ends. The greatwyrm can hold only one creature with this attack at a time.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (2d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 26 Strength save or fall prone.
Breath Weapon (recharge 5–6). Choose Elemental Breath or Sapping Breath.
Elemental Breath. Each creature in a 300-ft. cone makes a DC 25 Dexterity save, taking 84 (13d12) cold damage on a failure or half on a success.
Sapping Breath. Each creature in a 300-ft. cone makes a DC 25 Constitution save. A failure leaves the creature unconscious for 1 minute. An unconscious creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on the first save has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of the greatwyrm’s next turn.
Change Shape. Magically take the form of any Medium or Small creature, retaining the greatwyrm’s statistics except size. The form ends if the greatwyrm drops to 0 HP or spends an action to end it.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The creature has 3 legendary actions. It can take one option at the end of another creature’s turn and regains spent actions at the start of its turn.
Attack (1 action). Make one Claw or Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity save or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and fall prone. The greatwyrm can then fly up to half its flying speed.

gm.title: Mythic actions
lines:
For 1 hour after Metallic Awakening activates, the greatwyrm can spend legendary actions on these options.
Bite (1 action). Make one Bite attack.
Shattering Roar (2 actions). Each creature in a 120-ft.-radius sphere centered on the greatwyrm must succeed on a DC 26 Constitution save or take 19 (3d12) thunder damage and be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Description
lines: A violet faerie dragon who serves the Summer Queen. Bavlorna caught him in an enchanted silver cage before he could report the Hourglass Coven’s takeover of Prismeer.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Limited Telepathy. Talavar can speak telepathically with other faerie dragons within 60 ft.
Magic Resistance. He makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
+1 Tiny Sword. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d4 + 6) piercing damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 1 piercing damage.
Euphoria Breath (recharge 5–6). Choose one creature within 5 ft. It must pass a DC 11 Wisdom save or lose its reactions for 1 minute. At the start of each of its turns, roll a d6. On 1–4, it takes no action or bonus action and spends all movement going in a random direction. On 5–6, it stays put and can only attempt the DC 11 Wisdom save, which ends the effect on success.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Superior Invisibility. Talavar and anything he wears or carries become magically invisible. This lasts until his concentration ends, as if concentrating on a spell.

gm.title: Innate spellcasting
lines: Talavar uses Charisma (spell save DC 13) and needs no material components. As a violet faerie dragon, he knows the spells of his current color and all earlier colors. Each is available 1/day: Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Color Spray, Mirror Image, Suggestion, Major Image, Hallucinatory Terrain, and Polymorph.

gm.title: Silver birdcage
lines: While locked inside, Talavar cannot cast spells. His Euphoria Breath still works. The cage cannot be destroyed, and its lock cannot be picked. Jingle Jangle has the key. Knock or similar magic can also open it. If released, Talavar offers his tiny sword and departs to report to his queen.

lines: Initiative +2. AC 15 (+2 Dex, +3 luck), touch 15, flat-footed 13. Base attack +3, grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +5.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Rapier +6 melee (1d6).
Full attack. Three rapier strikes +6 melee (1d6 each) with Blinding Speed. A sith cannot use Blinding Speed if wielding a heavy weapon.
Fear Aura (Su). At will, opponents within 30 ft. make a DC 14 Will save or are stunned for 1 round. A successful save grants immunity to this sith's aura for 1 day.
Shadow Form (Su). As a standard action, assume the appearance of a nonmagical shadow. In this form the sith can move and perceive its surroundings, but cannot attack.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 5/silver. Immune to fire. Darkvision 120 ft. and low-light vision. The +3 luck bonus to AC is already included. Reroll one failed save per day. Direct sunlight deals 3 damage each round without a save. Shade reduces this to 1 damage per round.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines: Casts Necromancy spells as a 6th-level wizard. No prepared spell list is given. For a quick encounter, ray of enfeeblement, blindness/deafness, and vampiric touch are options. Spell save DC 13 + spell level.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Craft (alchemy) +10, Decipher Script +10, Gather Information +10, Hide +12, Knowledge (arcana) +10, Listen +15, Move Silently +9, Ride +8, Spellcraft +10, Spot +10, Use Magic Device +10. Scribe Scroll, Silent Spell, Still Spell. Speaks Sylvan and at least four local languages.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land in the Shadow Rift. Solitary or bevy of 3–5. Standard treasure. Always lawful evil.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The source describes Blinding Speed as three full attacks and gives a three-strike full-attack line. Use that line as the total rather than multiplying it again.
The source says ‘damage resistance 5/silver.’ This profile treats that notation as damage reduction, consistent with the other shadow fey.

gm.title: Description
lines: Granny Nightshade rules Thither from Loomlurch. Her skin resembles rotten bark beneath her toymaker’s disguise, and the windup key in her back slows as her temper worsens.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Boon of Immortality. Effects cannot age Skabatha, and old age cannot kill her.
Forgetfulness. The first creature Skabatha sees after a long rest becomes invisible to her. She cannot recall seeing it, and even her truesight cannot reveal it to her. This lasts until the end of her next long rest.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 25 (6d6 + 4) poison damage in her normal form, or 2 (1d4) poison damage when she is Tiny.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell, using Wisdom (spell save DC 14) without material components.
At will: Detect Magic, Druidcraft, Speak with Animals.
2/day each: Polymorph, Remove Curse, Speak with Plants.
1/day each: Awaken (cast as an action), Plane Shift (self only).

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Alter Size. Skabatha shrinks to Tiny (4–8 inches tall) or returns to normal. If the available space cannot hold her normal form, she grows only as large as will fit. Worn and carried equipment changes with her. While Tiny, she deals the reduced Claw damage above, rolls Dexterity (Stealth) checks with advantage, and rolls Strength checks and Strength saves with disadvantage. All other statistics stay the same.

gm.title: Hourglass Coven shared spells
lines: When Skabatha, Bavlorna Blightstraw and Endelyn Moongrave are all within 30 ft. of one another, any one of them can use an action to cast Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Finger of Death, Glibness, Locate Creature, or Mass Suggestion. Shared spells require no material components and use save DC 14. Each is available once to the coven as a whole, with all uses restored at dawn.

gm.title: Loomlurch encounter
lines: When her clockwork key stops, Skabatha lashes out at anything nearby until a victory or other good turn lifts her mood. Each time she flies into such a rage, 1d3 redcaps sprout in the garden at L15. The key is part of her body and cannot be removed while she lives. Loomlurch’s other defenders try to capture intruders alive. If the fight goes badly, Skabatha rides her Flying Rocking Horse to Motherhorn. Bavlorna Blightstraw goes there too if present. If Skabatha dies, a beetle tells her killer that Endelyn Moongrave can be killed permanently during a real or symbolic eclipse.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, appendix B, pp. 215 and 218. Loomlurch procedures in ch. 3, p. 114.

lines: A celestial weaver of fate can bind two allies together so that each suffers the harm dealt to the other.

lines: Perception 23, Stealth 11. Resists radiant damage. Immune to fire, lightning, and psychic damage. Truesight 60 ft. Language Celestial. Telepathy 120 ft.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str -2, Dex +1, Con +2, Int +7, Wis +13, Cha +5

gm.title: Traits
lines:
