Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Inexorable Thread attacks.
Inexorable Thread. Melee or ranged spell attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. Hit 27 (5d8 + 5) radiant damage. On a hit, the witch can teleport with its gear up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.
Destiny Distortion Wave (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 60-ft. cone make a DC 17 Wisdom save. Failure deals 55 force damage and gives disadvantage on checks, attacks, and saves for 1 minute. Repeat the save at the end of each turn to end the disadvantage. Success halves the damage and avoids the disadvantage.
Bind Fates (1/day). One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On failure, bind it to one ally of that target, chosen by the witch. Damage and conditions that would affect either bound creature affect its partner instead. A creature can have only one partner. Greater Restoration, Heal, Remove Curse, or comparable magic ends the bond.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Cutting the Thread. Choose a visible creature at 0 HP within 30 ft. It loses its stability if stable and immediately rolls a death save.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Parry Spell. When the witch beats a save DC by 5 or more against a spell of 4th level or lower that targets only it, the spell rebounds on the caster. Use the original caster’s circle, save DC, attack bonus, and spellcasting ability.

gm.title: Encounter Notes
lines: Fear of Cards. Bringing a Deck of Many Things near the witch causes it to wail and disintegrate.

lines: An animated pile of bones that can fight with a blade or bow. It understands commands even though it cannot speak.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Shortsword. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Vulnerable to bludgeoning, force, and thunder. Resists piercing and slashing. Immune to Exhaustion and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Bone Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical. The skeleton uses pieces of its own bones as bow ammunition and replaces them at dusk.
Hail of Bones. When bludgeoning, force, or thunder damage reduces the skeleton to 0 HP, it explodes and deals 4 piercing damage to each creature within 5 ft.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Bone Bow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing. Halve any HP the target regains before the start of the skeleton’s next turn.
Bone Knife. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing. A creature hit has disadvantage on attack rolls for the remainder of this turn.

gm.title: Description
lines: A roaming human skeleton whose skull has been carved into a key for the gate in the Sewn Sisters' lair. It usually flees when approached.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands the languages it knew in life. It cannot speak.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Spider Climb. The skeleton can traverse difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Tomb Traps. The skeleton does not trigger traps in tomb rooms or on tomb doors.
Intact Remains. At 0 hit points it falls apart, leaving its skull and other bones intact.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two melee Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

gm.title: Finding the keys
lines: Place one skeleton on each of the first five tomb levels in a location marked by a skull on the level map. A DC 12 Wisdom (Survival) check follows a key's trail to the nearest unexplored location bearing that mark. The skulls are triangle, square, pentagon, hexagon, and octagon in level order. The key flees if it can to avoid capture or destruction. Characters can capture the skeleton or remove its skull.

gm.title: Skeleton gate
lines: In area 71, completing each trial in areas 72 through 76 exposes one corresponding keyhole. Insert the matching skull and turn it clockwise. Once all five tumblers are unlocked, pull the door open to reach the stairs to area 77. Damage and spells cannot open the gate or remove its seals. The Sewn Sisters enter from the Border Ethereal when the party opens all five keyholes with the keys in hand. A hag that takes a key retreats into the Border Ethereal with it.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Tomb of Annihilation, pp. 126–127 and 180 (area 71), adapting the Skeleton from Monster Manual (2014), p. 272.

gm.title: Description
lines: A stocky, shaggy shapeshifter slips into the skin of someone it killed and waits for that person’s friends.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +3. AC 15 (+3 Dex, +2 natural), touch 13, flat-footed 12. Base attack +2, grapple +4. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +6, Will +5. Bluff +6, Disguise +5, Hide +6, Intimidate +6. Dodge. Any land or underground. Solitary, family of 3–6, or clan of 4–12. Double standard treasure. Usually chaotic evil. Advances by class.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Claw +4 melee (1d6+2).
Full attack. Two claws +4 melee (1d6+2 each) and bite −1 melee (1d4+1 plus poison).
Poison (Ex). Injury, Fortitude DC 13, initial and secondary damage 1d6 Dexterity.
Skin Theft (Su). Use one full-round action to skin a humanoid it killed and another to put on the skin. It takes on the victim’s appearance and natural armor bonus, and gains +8 racial on Disguise, without acquiring memories or abilities. Whenever it takes damage, make a Reflex save at DC 10 + damage taken. Failure bursts the disguise.

gm.title: Tactics and languages
lines: It lures isolated prey, then uses its bite or attacks with its clan. Its mixed dialect borrows from languages it has heard. A listener has a 5% chance per language they know of understanding the gist of any statement.

gm.title: Description
lines: A leathery, batlike predator that rakes prey while flying past. Hunters sometimes train it as a short-distance mount.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Tropical or subtropical land. Rare. Flock. The table lists activity at any time and the ecology notes peak activity by day. Carnivore and scavenger. Intelligence 2–4. No treasure. Neutral with evil tendencies. Appearing 2d4. No magic resistance. Wingspan 12–21 feet. Morale 11–12, +1 if trained.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Claw pass. Make two claw attacks for 1d4 each from above or behind, then fly out of reach. A flock normally concentrates these passes on one target. If both claws hit and the victim weighs less than half the skinwing’s carrying capacity, carry it aloft and deal 2d4 damage per round thereafter.
Bite. Deal 2d4 damage while landed or flying very slowly. Its AC is 7 while it uses this attack.
A skinwing carrying a rider cannot attack.

gm.title: Flight and loads
lines: Carry up to 30 pounds per HD. It needs a drop-off to take off with a rider and must save vs. paralysis every half hour of mounted flight. Failure exhausts it and forces an immediate landing. Its flight ceiling is about 1,000 feet. At 50% or more damage it loses flight until fully healed.

gm.title: Description
lines: A many-legged nightmare that climbs walls and ceilings. The Golgari put these horrors to work guarding their territory.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Spider Climb. The horror can climb difficult surfaces, even upside down on ceilings, without an ability check.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the horror has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. The horror can use Maddening Presence and makes one Bite and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (4d10 + 6) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 24 (4d8 + 6) slashing damage.
Maddening Presence. Choose a visible creature within 30 ft. If it can see or hear the horror, it makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure it is paralyzed until the end of its next turn. On a success it is immune to this horror’s Maddening Presence for 24 hours.

gm.title: Optional primary features
lines:
Choose or roll one primary and one secondary feature using the d4 tables on p. 204. Add them to the base stat block.
1. Avoidance. If an effect allows a save for half damage, a success instead deals no damage and a failure deals half.
2. Damage Resistances. The horror gains resistance to necrotic and psychic damage.
3. Innate Spellcasting. With Charisma and spell save DC 17, it can cast Darkness 3/day and Fear and Phantasmal Killer 1/day each without material components.
4. Psychic Rebuke. When a melee attack damages the horror, it can use its reaction to deal 10 (3d6) psychic damage to each creature within 5 ft.

gm.title: Optional secondary features
lines:
1. Grasping Tendrils. The horror has four tendrils, each with AC 12 and 10 HP. Destroying a tendril does not harm the horror. As a bonus action, it can target a visible creature within 10 ft. The target must make a DC 19 Dexterity save or be grappled (escape DC 19). A tendril can hold only one target at a time.
2. Indomitable Mind. The horror becomes immune to being charmed.
3. Keen Senses. It gains advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, sound, or smell.
4. Mind Sight. Magical darkness does not impede its darkvision.

gm.title: Optional madness
lines: If you use the optional madness rule on p. 203, record each time a character fails the save against Maddening Presence. See Flying Horror for the shared end-of-encounter save and severity table.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 205. Optional horror rules on pp. 203–204.

lines: Three treacherous leaders share one body. Skull lords command undead armies in the Shadowfell and scheme against each other even while bound together.

lines:

Attack (1 action). Make one Bone Staff or Deathly Ray attack.

Summon Undead (2 actions). Summon up to five skeletons or zombies in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. They roll initiative and act on the next available turn. They obey the skull lord and remain until destroyed. The skull lord can have at most five Undead from this ability at once.

lines: A warlock of Baba Yaga also known as Charmay. A warning from Endelyn drove her out of the League of Malevolence and into Motherhorn.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Special Equipment. Her Eldritch Staff holds up to 10 charges and restores 1d6 + 4 spent charges at dawn. When she spends its final charge, roll a d20. A 1 destroys the staff.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Eldritch Staff attacks. Skylla can substitute Spellcasting for one attack.
Eldritch Staff. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) with two hands. On the hit, Skylla can spend up to 3 staff charges. Each adds 4 (1d8) lightning damage.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:

1/day each. Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Faerie Fire, Fly, Hypnotic Pattern, Invisibility, Mage Armor.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Eldritch Escape. When Skylla takes damage, she can spend 3 staff charges. She becomes invisible and teleports with her equipment to a visible unoccupied space within 60 ft. The invisibility ends at the start of her next turn or earlier if she attacks, casts a spell, or deals damage.

gm.title: Motherhorn workshop
lines: The command word nocturli animates the eight props in M12. Use Animated Armor for each, with AC 19 for the stovepipe and gate, AC 15 for the coffin and wooden owlbear, AC 13 for the plaster elf king and cake, and AC 11 for the boar mannequin and stuffed golem. While they fight, Skylla takes Golmo and retreats toward the darklings in M2. If forced to surrender, she can say alfarian to return the props to normal.

gm.title: Slaad control gems
lines:
A slaad born from the Spawning Stone carries a magical control gem in its head. Once another creature claims the gem, the slaad is Charmed and obeys the bearer. It stops being Charmed if the bearer or the bearer's allies harm it, if someone returns the gem to the slaad, or if Greater Restoration destroys the gem when cast on the slaad.
Wish can retrieve the gem. If the slaad fails its save against Imprisonment, the caster gets the gem and the slaad stays free. Removing the gem from an Incapacitated slaad takes 1 minute and a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Failure deals 22 (4d10) Piercing damage to the slaad.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A towering, serpent-bodied demon with six pincers and a venomous tail spike.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Huge Fiend (Demon, Category 3), typically chaotic evil

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saves Str +9, Dex +3, Con +8. Athletics +9, Perception +7. Fire resistance. Immune to Flanked. Darkvision 60 ft., Soulsight 30 ft., passive Perception 17. Abyssal, Goblin, Infernal.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make four attacks in any combination of Pincer, Sword, and Javelin. One of the four can be replaced with Tail Spike. Spend 1 soul to add one Pincer, Sword, or Javelin attack.
Pincer. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. The target is Grappled (escape DC 17) and Restrained while that grapple lasts. Each of the demon’s six pincers can hold a grappled target or wield a weapon.
Sword. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack +9, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage.
Tail Spike. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d10 + 6) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution save or become Poisoned for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and ending the effect on a success.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Dive Deep (1 soul). Take the Disengage action and gain a burrowing speed equal to the demon’s walking speed until the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Encounter uses
lines: Use Pincer to hold the front line and Javelin to reach foes farther away. Track the soul total as the demon spends it on extra attacks or burrowing. At zero souls, Lethe can turn it against the closest creature it senses, even an ally.

gm.title: MCDM demon soul rules
lines:
Soul count. Use the printed starting total or roll the listed dice. Souls spent on a feature are deducted from the total. A demon can accumulate souls without a maximum.
Soul Devourer. When the demon drops a creature other than a Construct or Undead to 0 HP, or deals damage to a dying creature, that creature makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure, the demon consumes its soul, adds 1 to its soul count, and the creature dies. Only Wish can restore it to life.
Lethe. At 0 souls, the demon has advantage on attacks and disadvantage on saving throws, and its Intelligence is 3. On each turn it must use its movement to get as close as possible to the nearest creature it senses with Soulsight. If able, it must then use its action to attack that creature and attempt to kill it. It can pursue no other goal until its soul count rises.
Soulsight. Within the creature’s listed radius, it perceives creatures other than Constructs and Undead. This counts as seeing them for its features. Physical objects, total cover, and supernatural effects do not block this sense unless a rule says they do.

gm.title: Description
lines: A person bent on revenge can undergo a ritual that leaves their mind inside a living puddle. The resulting ooze tastes the ground as it follows its quarry.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands the languages it knew in its previous form but can't speak.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Blinded, deafened, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, unconscious.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
False Appearance. If motionless when combat starts, the tracker has advantage on initiative. A creature that hasn't seen the tracker move or act must pass a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to recognize it as a creature rather than a puddle.
Liquid Form. The tracker may enter and stop in an enemy's space. It can pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Spider Climb. The tracker can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings while upside down, without an ability check.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Life Leech. Choose one Large or smaller creature the tracker can see within 5 ft. It makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is grappled (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, it is restrained and cannot breathe unless it can breathe water. It takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The tracker can grapple one target at a time. While the grapple lasts, the tracker takes half any damage dealt to it (round down), and the target takes the rest.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Watery Stealth. While underwater, take the Hide action and make the Dexterity (Stealth) check with advantage.

gm.title: Creation ritual
lines: Hags, liches, and priests of gods of vengeance know the ritual. It requires a willing creature driven by revenge. The ritual drains the creature's moisture and kills its body. Its mind persists as the tracker.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Angelic Weapons. The solar’s weapon attacks are magical. When the solar hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 6d8 radiant damage (included in the attack). Divine Awareness. The solar knows if it hears a lie. Innate Spellcasting. The solar’s spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 25). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: detect evil and good, invisibility (self only) 3/day each: blade barrier, dispel evil and good, resurrection 1/day each: commune, control weather Magic Resistance. The solar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. The solar makes two greatsword attacks. Greatsword. Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage. Slaying Longbow. Ranged Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage. If the target is a creature that has 100 hit points or fewer, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or die. Flying Sword. The solar releases its greatsword to hover magically in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. If the solar can see the sword, the solar can mentally command it as a bonus action to fly up to 50 feet and either make one attack against a target or return to the solar’s hands. If the hovering sword is targeted by any effect, the solar is considered to be holding it. The hovering sword falls if the solar dies. Healing Touch (4/Day). The solar touches another creature. The target magically regains 40 (8d8 + 4) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines: The solar can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The solar regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. Teleport. The solar magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Searing Burst (Costs 2 Actions). The solar emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a 10-foot radius must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Blinding Gaze (Costs 3 Actions). The solar targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until magic such as the lesser restoration spell removes the blindness.

gm.title: Description
lines: Green worms infest this undead creature. The priest Kyuss created the first spawn in service to Orcus, and the worms spread the curse to new hosts.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the spawn regains 10 hit points if it has at least 1 hit point and is outside sunlight and running water. Acid, fire, or radiant damage prevents regeneration at the start of its next turn. The spawn is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
Worms. An effect that cures disease or removes a curse kills the spawn's worms and removes its Burrowing Worm action.
Unusual Nature. The spawn needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and use Burrowing Worm if available.

gm.title: Burrowing worm mechanics
lines: The worm is a Tiny Undead with AC 6, 1 hit point, a speed of 1 ft., and a score of 2 (−4) in every ability. A worm on the skin can be killed normally or scraped off as an action. If it remains, it burrows at the end of the target's next turn and deals 1 piercing damage. At the end of each of the target's turns after that, it takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage per worm, up to 10d6 total. If this reduces the target to 0 hit points, it dies and rises 10 minutes later as a spawn of Kyuss. An effect that cures disease or removes a curse kills all worms infesting the target.

gm.title: Reading Black Flag stat blocks
lines:
Rules source. Black Flag Reference Document, Monsters.
The printed modifiers and fixed HP are ready to use. For a Dexterity (Stealth) check to avoid the creature, use its Perception value as the DC. For a Wisdom (Perception) check to detect it, use its Stealth value as the DC.
Condition resistance gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end the named condition. Condition vulnerability gives disadvantage. Apply damage resistance and vulnerability to the amount of damage instead.

gm.title: Description
lines: A powerful manscorpion can rise at sunset with its flesh burned black and its eyes glowing red. It remembers the combat and magic it wielded in life.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Very rare in tropical or subtropical deserts and caves. Solitary, nocturnal, consumes life. Intelligence 5–18. Treasure J, K, M, Q. Fearless morale (19–20). No magic resistance. Stands 6 feet tall, with a 4-foot body and 10-foot tail. Add 2,000 XP if it casts spells.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Claws and sting. Two claws at 1d4 + 1 each and a tail sting at 1d4, or use weapon damage. The sting requires a save vs. poison at −3. On failure the victim dies immediately. On success the victim permanently loses 1 point each of Strength, Constitution, and Dexterity.
Retained abilities. Keep the original manscorpion’s combat and spellcasting abilities. It gains no further levels.

gm.title: Defenses
lines: Turned as a lich. Requires red steel or a magical weapon of +1 or better to hit. Immune to sleep, charm, hold, cold, death magic, poison, and mind-affecting spells. Sunlight harms it as it harms a living Nimmurian manscorpion, but the spawn reforms at night. It heals 1 HP per turn in darkness and can reform from dust. To destroy it permanently, sprinkle its ashes with holy water from a temple of Idu (Ixion), bless them, and scatter them to the four winds.

gm.title: Origin and Red Curse
lines: A manscorpion of at least 11 HD killed by sunlight has a 1% chance per Hit Die to rise at sunset. The ash rite prevents this. A spawn neither gains Legacies nor requires cinnabryl.

Confusion Ray. On a failed DC 13 Wisdom save, the target loses its reactions until the end of its next turn. On that turn it cannot move, and it spends its action making a melee or ranged attack against a randomly selected creature within reach or range. If unable to attack, it does nothing that turn.

Wounding Ray. The target makes a DC 13 Constitution save. It takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage on a failure, or half on a success.

gm.title: Shared spectral hag rules
lines:
Printed source. Hag, Spectral, pp. 108–111.
Chilling Touch (Su). A target hit by the spectral hag’s incorporeal touch makes a DC 15 Fortitude save. Failure gives it 2 negative levels. The touch still deals its listed hit point damage on a successful save.
Create Spectre (Su). A victim whose levels reach 0 through Chilling Touch and who dies rises as a spectre under the hag’s control. Spectres she creates can travel with her, obey her commands, and be called to aid her in combat.
Daylight suppresses the hag’s special powers without dealing damage. Her touch reaches creatures on either the Ethereal Plane or the Material Plane and keeps her original Strength bonus.
When former covey members die during the same evil ceremony, they may retain their covey. A former covey member the spectral hag kills rises as a spectral hag under her control.

gm.title: Description
lines: An Azorius gynosphinx who uses law magic to compel truth and imprison offenders.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Inscrutable. The sphinx is immune to effects that sense its emotions or read its thoughts and to divination spells it chooses to refuse. Wisdom (Insight) checks to gauge its intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.
Magic Weapons. The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
The sphinx is a 9th-level Azorius wizard spellcaster. Intelligence sets its save DC to 16 and its spell attack bonus to +8. It casts these prepared spells without material components.
Cantrips (at will). Friends, Mage Hand, Message.
1st level (4 slots). Command, Ensnaring Strike, Shield.
2nd level (3 slots). Calm Emotions, Hold Person, Suggestion.
3rd level (3 slots). Clairvoyance, Counterspell, Dispel Magic.
4th level (3 slots). Banishment, Divination.
5th level (1 slot). Dominate Person.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage on a hit.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The sphinx has 3 legendary actions and recovers spent actions at the start of its turn. It can take one option at a time, at the end of another creature's turn. It cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before it can use them.
Claw Attack (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Teleport (2 actions). The sphinx and its worn or carried equipment magically move up to 120 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space.
Cast a Spell (3 actions). Cast a prepared spell, spending a spell slot as normal.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
When the sphinx is in its lair, it can choose one of these magical effects on initiative count 20, losing initiative ties. It must finish a short or long rest before it can repeat an effect. It cannot use a lair action while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before it can use one.
Reroll initiative. Every creature in the lair rerolls initiative. The sphinx can keep its existing result.
Change age. Every creature in the lair makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it becomes 1d20 years older or younger, as the sphinx chooses. The creature cannot become younger than 1 year. Greater Restoration can restore its age.
Shift the lair in time. Move everything in the lair up to 10 years forward or backward. Only the sphinx notices immediately. Wish can return its caster and up to seven creatures the caster chooses to their normal time.
Shift planes. The sphinx transports itself and up to seven other creatures it can see in the lair to another plane. It cannot use lair actions while away. It can return to the lair as a bonus action on its turn and bring up to seven creatures with it.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 183, gives the Gynosphinx a replacement spell list. The base block and lair actions are in the 2014 Monster Manual, pp. 281–282.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Inscrutable. No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage. Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair). If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

gm.title: Actions

gm.title: Description
lines: A prophetic guardian of Labyrinth ruins and archives. It honors those who answer its riddles.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Perception 18. Stealth 12. Resistant to exhaustion. Immune to psychic damage, Charmed, and Frightened. Truesight 120 ft. Speaks Common, Qoradan, and Sphinx. Telepathy 120 ft.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: STR +8 · DEX +2 · CON +3 · INT +8 · WIS +8 · CHA +4

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Inscrutable. Effects that sense emotion or read thoughts fail against the sphinx, as do divination spells it chooses to refuse. Wisdom (Insight) checks about its intent or honesty have disadvantage.
Magical Claws. A Claw attack counts as magical and deals an extra 2d8 force damage on a hit, already included below.
Monstrosity Resilience. The sphinx resists exhaustion and has Frightened immunity under its listed defenses.
Truth Speaker. The sphinx must speak truthfully to anyone who solves one of its riddles or passes one of its tests.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Ram and two Claw attacks, or three Arcane Bolt attacks. Spellcasting can replace one of these attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing and 9 (2d8) force damage.
Ram. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning and 9 (2d8) force damage.
Arcane Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 21 (5d6 + 4) force damage.
Spellcasting. Wisdom, save DC 16, no components. At will: detect magic, mage hand, minor illusion. 3/day each: dispel magic, divination (as an action), suggestion, tongues. 1/day each: banishment, geas (as an action).

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Dire Warning. One creature within 60 ft. that can hear the sphinx makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target is Frightened for 1 minute and has speed 0 while Frightened this way. A failure by 5 or more also leaves it Paralyzed for the same duration. It repeats the save at the end of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines:
The sphinx has three legendary actions per round. It chooses one option at the end of another creature’s turn and refreshes its pool at the start of its own.
Teleport. Move magically up to 120 ft. to a visible unoccupied space, taking worn and carried equipment along.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Use Spellcasting.
Lacerating Swipe (2 actions). Creatures in a 15-ft. cone make a DC 16 Dexterity save. A failure deals 7 (2d6) slashing damage and opens a bleeding wound. The wound costs the target 3 (1d6) HP at the start of each of its turns. Magical healing closes it, as does an action with a successful DC 16 Wisdom (Medicine) check by any creature.

lines: Plate armor bolted to its body (AC 17 for this printing).

lines: Lightning, poison. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks unless made with adamantine weapons.

lines: Understands its maker’s languages. Cannot speak.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Aversion of Fire. After taking fire damage, the guardian has disadvantage on attacks and ability checks through the end of its next turn.
Berserk. At the start of a turn with 40 HP or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6 the guardian goes berserk and attacks the nearest creature it can see. If it cannot reach and attack a creature, it attacks an object, favoring one smaller than itself. It stays berserk until destroyed, healed to full HP, or calmed by its creator. To calm it, the creator uses an action within 60 ft. and succeeds on a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. The guardian must be able to hear its creator. Further damage at 40 HP or fewer can cause it to go berserk again.
Immutable Form. Spells and other effects cannot change its form.
Lightning Absorption. Lightning damage instead heals it for the same amount.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

gm.title: Description
lines: A stone giant transformed through service to Baphomet. It builds mazes as both works of art and hunting grounds.

lines:

Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack. Make two Glaive attacks or two Rock attacks.
Glaive. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit must succeed on a DC 19 Strength save or fall prone. After each throw, roll a d6. On a 1–3, the stalker runs out of rocks.
Erupting Horns (Recharge 5–6). Choose a visible point on the ground within 60 ft. Six stone horns rise in a cylinder centered there, 30 ft. high and 30 ft. in radius, then crumble. Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell with no components, using Wisdom (save DC 15).
1/day each. Meld into Stone, Stone Shape, Wall of Stone.

lines: An emissary of an Elder Evil can fuse with a mortal cultist, replacing their personality. Its body breaks into a swarm of insects when defeated.

lines: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Return to Worms. At 0 hit points, the mage breaks apart into a Swarm of Insects in its space. It reforms from the swarm 24 hours later unless someone destroys the swarm first.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Slam or Eldritch Bolt attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The target must make a DC 19 Constitution save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

lines:

lines:

Illumination. With 1 or more hit points, it casts bright light to 20 ft. and dim light another 20 ft.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Radiant Eruption. Melee or ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Deal 20 (5d6 + 3) radiant damage on a hit. A creature hit must also pass a DC 14 Wisdom save or be blinded for 1 minute. It can repeat that save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.
Possession (Recharge 6). Choose one Humanoid the apparition can see within 5 ft. On a failed DC 14 Charisma save, the apparition vanishes into the target and takes control. It keeps its own alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma, and its immunity to being charmed or frightened. Otherwise use the host’s statistics, without access to its knowledge, class features or proficiencies.
The possession ends if the host drops to 0 hit points or leaves the Astral Plane, if the apparition spends a bonus action to leave, or if an effect such as Dispel Evil and Good forces it out. It returns to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the host and is destroyed if that space lies outside the Astral Plane. After a successful initial save or the end of a possession, the target is immune to this apparition’s Possession for 24 hours.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

lines: Intercept Attack. When another creature within 5 ft. is hit by an attack roll, the defender can grant it +5 AC against that attack, potentially turning the hit into a miss. The defender must see both attacker and target.

gm.title: Clockwork enhancements
lines:
For an individual clockwork, choose or roll one enhancement and one potential malfunction, both on d10.
1. Camouflaged. Gain Stealth proficiency if needed. While still, the clockwork passes for an inactive machine.
2. Sensors. Raise darkvision to at least 120 ft. and add Perception proficiency if needed.
3. Improved Armor. Increase AC by 2.
4. Increased Speed. Increase speed by 10 ft.
5. Reinforced Construction. Gain resistance to force, lightning and thunder damage.
6. Self-Repairing. At the start of its turn, recover 5 HP if it has at least 1 HP. Lightning damage skips the next recovery.
7. Sturdy Frame. Add its number of Hit Dice to its maximum HP.
8. Suction. Gain a 30-ft. climbing speed.
9. Vocal Resonator. It speaks rudimentary Common or Gnomish, as its maker decides.
10. Water Propulsion. Gain a 30-ft. swimming speed.

gm.title: Clockwork malfunctions
lines:
1. Faulty Sensors. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, the clockwork is blinded until turn end.
2. Flawed Targeting. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, its attack rolls have disadvantage until turn end.
3. Ground Fault. Gain vulnerability to lightning damage.
4. Imprinting Loop. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, it mistakes a visible creature within 30 ft. for its maker. It avoids harming that creature for 1 minute or until the creature attacks or damages it.
5. Leaking Lubricant. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, it gains one level of exhaustion despite immunity.
6. Limited Steering. It moves in straight lines, turning up to 90 degrees before moving and once at the halfway point. It can rotate freely on a turn when it uses none of its speeds.
7. Overactive Sense of Self-Preservation. At the start of a combat turn while at half HP or less, roll a d6. On a 1, the clockwork retreats if it can. If it cannot retreat, it keeps fighting.
8. Overheats. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, it is incapacitated until turn end.
9. Rusty Gears. It has disadvantage on initiative rolls and its speed drops by 10 ft.
10. Weak Armor. Remove its immunity to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical, non-adamantine attacks.

lines: Speed · 50 ft., fly 50 ft. (hover), swim 50 ft.

gm.title: Description
lines: A storm giant near the end of its life may disperse into a lasting storm. It resumes giant form briefly to speak, perform a task, or defend its lair.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. The giant can breathe air and water.
Legendary Resistance (1/day). When the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Lightning Sword attacks or use Wind Javelin twice.
Lightning Sword. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 40 (9d6 + 9) lightning damage.
Wind Javelin. Choose a creature the giant can see within 600 ft. The javelin strikes automatically for 19 (3d6 + 9) force damage and disappears.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The giant has 3 legendary actions, which it regains at the start of its turn. Spend the listed cost to take one option just after another creature's turn. It must be able to act. If surprised, it can begin using these options after its first turn.
Gust (1 action). Choose a creature the giant can see within 60 ft. On a failed DC 18 Strength save, a magical gust moves the creature up to 20 ft. in a horizontal direction of the giant's choice.
Thunderbolt (2 actions). Choose a creature the giant can see within 600 ft. The creature takes 22 (4d10) thunder damage on a failed DC 18 Dexterity save, or half as much on a success.
One with the Storm (3 actions). The giant vanishes into its lair's storm and can choose to reappear anywhere in the lair at the start of any of its turns. While dispersed, it can take only lair actions and cannot be targeted by attacks, spells, or other effects. It can disperse only in its lair, and only if another creature is not quelling the storm with Control Weather or similar magic.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, after creatures tied at that count, use one option in giant or storm form. Choose a different option from the one used in the prior round. The giant must be able to act and, if surprised, must finish its first turn before using a lair action.
Deafening Boom. Choose a point in the lair. Each creature within 20 ft. of it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution save or become deafened until the end of its next turn.
Fog. Choose a point in the lair and create a 20-ft.-radius sphere of fog, or murky water underwater. It spreads around corners and heavily obscures its area. Wind cannot disperse it. It lasts until the giant ends it without spending an action.
Gale. Create a line of wind, or current underwater, 60 ft. long and 10 ft. wide from a point in the lair. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 18 Strength save or be pushed 15 ft. in its direction. The gale clears gas and vapor and extinguishes exposed flames. Each protected flame has a 50 percent chance of going out.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
One or more of these effects surround the lair.
Downpour. Rain, snow, blowing dust, or blowing sand is constant within 1 mile, as appropriate for the region. Rain fills or overflows waterways. Snow, dust, and sand build deep drifts or dunes.
Lightning. Lightning and thunder are constant within 5 miles, day and night.
Winds. High winds within 1 mile prevent fires from being lit in unprotected places.
When the giant dies, lightning, thunder, and high winds cease immediately. Rain, snow, and blowing dust taper off within 1d8 days.

lines: A Perch Guard knight who can open a retreat route for an ally. Riffin the Ash-Knight uses this profile with lawful good alignment.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Half plate and shield. Con save +5, Wis save +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Understands Auran and speaks Birdfolk.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Talons. The knight has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces their talons can grip.
Maneuver (2/day). After the knight hits, an ally within 5 ft. of the target can use their reaction to move away from it at half speed without provoking an opportunity attack.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Short Sword attacks.
Short Sword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Wing Crest Shield (1/day). Use the shield to cast Gust of Wind (save DC 15).

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: After hitting with Talons, the knight can grapple the target as a bonus action.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Glide. After falling at least 10 ft., the knight can spend a reaction to glide up to their speed in one direction while descending. They land in a free space at the end and take no fall damage. They need to be free of heavy objects, heavy weapons, and shields to glide. They can drop anything held as part of the same reaction.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Glide. After falling at least 10 ft., the tracker can spend a reaction to glide up to their speed in one direction while descending. lines: Skills Deception +9, Insight +5, Perception +5, Persuasion +9, Stealth +7 Resistances Cold, Fire, Poison, Psychic Senses Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 15 Languages Abyssal, Common, Infernal; telepathy 60 ft.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Incubus Form. When the succubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into an Incubus, using that stat block instead of this one.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. The succubus makes one Fiendish Touch attack and uses Charm or Draining Kiss. Fiendish Touch. Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Psychic damage. Charm. The succubus casts Dominate Person (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15). Draining Kiss. gm.title: Description
lines: A shapechanging fiend that starts by tempting mortals in their dreams, then visits them in a familiar guise.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold, fire, lightning, and poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Abyssal, Common, Infernal, and telepathy 60 ft.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Telepathic Bond. The fiend can communicate telepathically with a creature under its Charm regardless of distance or plane.
Shapechanger. Use an action to take the shape of a Small or Medium humanoid, or resume true form. Only size and speed can change. The fiend loses its fly speed in a wingless form. Worn and carried gear keep their form. On death it resumes its true form.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Claw (fiend form only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Charm. Choose one visible humanoid within 30 ft. It makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or becomes magically Charmed for 1 day and follows the fiend's verbal or telepathic commands. A target that suffers harm or receives a suicidal command can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success. After a successful save against the effect or when it ends, the target is immune to this fiend's Charm for 24 hours. The fiend can charm only one target at once. Charming a new target ends the effect on the previous one.
Draining Kiss. Kiss a willing creature or one under the fiend's Charm. It makes a DC 15 Constitution save against this magic, taking 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage on a failure or half on a success. Reduce its hit point maximum by the damage dealt until it finishes a long rest. It dies if this reduction brings its maximum to 0.
Etherealness. The fiend uses magic to move between the Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane.

gm.title: Forms
lines: A succubus and an incubus are forms of the same fiend. It can switch between them and typically prefers one. The book gives both forms a shared stat block.

gm.title: Printed source

gm.title: Description
lines: Anger can draw an eladrin into its summer aspect. Its magic feeds the fighting form's quick movement and fiery attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fearsome Presence. A creature other than an eladrin that starts its turn within 60 ft. must make a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened of this eladrin for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success. A successful save or the end of the effect gives it immunity to every eladrin's Fearsome Presence for 24 hours.
Magic Resistance. The eladrin has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Changeable Natures mechanics
lines: After finishing a long rest, an eladrin that is not incapacitated can adopt another season's stat block. Carry over its damage taken, conditions, and other ongoing effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Longsword or Longbow.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage with two hands, plus 9 (2d8) fire damage either way.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage and 9 (2d8) fire damage.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Fey Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space the eladrin can see, taking its worn and carried equipment.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Parry. The eladrin adds 3 to its AC against a melee attack that would hit it if it can see the attacker and is wielding a melee weapon.

gm.title: Description
lines: A winged silhouette of fractured light that heals its allies while exposing an enemy to their attacks.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saves Wis +7, Cha +9. Insight +7, Intimidation +9, Perception +7, Religion +6. Resists fire and radiant damage. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 17. Speaks Common and Primordial.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Corona. The nexus sheds bright sunlight within 120 ft. and dim light for another 120 ft.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Solar Arc attacks. An available Heavenly Collapse or Rejuvenating Flare can replace one of them.
Solar Arc. Melee or ranged spell attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d12 + 5) radiant damage.
Heavenly Collapse (2/day). Choose one visible enemy within 60 ft. Every ally of the nexus within 5 ft. of the enemy regains 20 HP. The enemy makes a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure it loses all damage resistances and is Blinded for 1 minute, with another save to end both effects at the end of each turn.
Rejuvenating Flare (1/day). One visible ally within 30 ft. regains 27 (5d10) HP and ends any of the Charmed, Dazed, Frightened, and Poisoned conditions affecting it.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines:
Convocation of Sunlight (2/day). Choose the nexus or another visible Elemental within 30 ft. That Elemental chooses Healing Radiance or Protective Light.
Healing Radiance. The Elemental regains 30 HP. Until the end of the nexus's next turn, non-Elementals within 10 ft. of it are Blinded.
Protective Light. Four motes orbit the Elemental for 1 minute. When its attack damages a creature, the Elemental can extinguish a mote to deal 14 (4d6) extra radiant damage to that creature (no action).

gm.title: Description
lines: A dryad bound to a swamp tree can lock enemies in its roots long enough to turn them into wood.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +9, Con +9, Wis +10. Acrobatics +6, Animal Handling +10, Arcana +6, Medicine +10, Survival +10. Resists acid, poison, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 15. Sylvan and any languages it spoke before binding.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Supernatural Resistance. Advantage on saves against supernatural effects.
Speak with Beasts and Plants. The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as though they shared a language.
Tree Stride (1/turn). Spend 10 ft. of movement to enter a living tree within reach and emerge in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of another living tree up to 60 ft. from the first. Each tree must be Large or larger.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks and use Entangling Roots if available.
Slam. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and is Poisoned for 1 minute. On a success it takes half the poison damage without the condition.
Entangling Roots (Recharge 5–6). Center a 15-ft.-radius area on a visible point within 60 ft. of the dryad. The radius is 30 ft. instead if the dryad stands within 5 ft. of its tree. Each creature in the area makes a DC 18 Strength save or takes 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and is Grappled (escape DC 14). It is Restrained while Grappled this way. If its third consecutive turn ends still Grappled, it is Petrified into a hardwood statue. The dryad can use an action to end that petrification, which also ends if it dies.
Fey Intimidation. Choose up to five visible creatures within 30 ft. Those that see the dryad make a DC 18 Wisdom save or become Frightened of it. A target repeats the save at the end of its turns. A creature that succeeds or recovers is immune to this dryad's Fey Intimidation for 24 hours.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Swamp Medicine (3/day). Touch a creature. It regains 18 (3d8 + 5) HP, or the dryad can remove one disease or neutralize one poison affecting it instead.

gm.title: Mundane Attacks (MCDM)
lines: A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.

gm.title: 2014 spell procedures
lines:
Command, at will. Action, 60 ft., one visible creature. On a failed DC 13 Wisdom save it follows a one-word order on its next turn. It must understand the language. Undead and directly harmful commands are ineligible. The spell ends if the target cannot comply. The DM resolves orders outside the listed examples. Approach ends the turn when it reaches within 5 ft. of the swarm by the shortest route. Drop ends the turn after dropping held items. Flee spends the turn moving away as quickly as it can. Grovel drops it prone and ends the turn. Halt prevents movement and actions, with minimum flight allowed if needed to stay aloft.
Comprehend Languages, at will. Action, self, 1 hour. Understand literal spoken language the swarm hears and writing it sees while touching the written surface. Read one page per minute. It cannot decode ciphers or signs outside a written language.
Detect Thoughts, at will. Action, self, concentration up to 1 minute. Read the surface thoughts of a visible creature within 30 ft. The creature must have Intelligence 4 or higher and speak a language. On a later action, switch targets or probe deeper. A probe alerts the target, which makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. Success ends the spell. Failure reveals reasoning, emotional state, and a major concern. A probed creature can use an action to end the spell by winning an Intelligence contest against the swarm while it remains the focus. On casting or as an action the swarm can also search for eligible unseen minds within 30 ft., then read them while in range. Two feet of rock, 2 inches of non-lead metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks that search.
Confusion, 1/day. Action, 90 ft., concentration up to 1 minute. Each creature in a 10-ft.-radius sphere around a point in range makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. A failure prevents reactions and requires a d10 at the start of each turn. On 1, roll a d8 for direction and spend all movement going that way without acting. On 2–6, the creature stays still and does nothing. On 7–8, it spends its action on one melee attack against a random creature in reach. If there is none, it does nothing. On 9–10, it moves and acts as usual. A DC 13 Wisdom save at the end of its turn ends the effect on that creature.
Dominate Monster, 1/day. Action, 60 ft., a visible creature, concentration up to 1 hour. The target makes a DC 13 Wisdom save, with advantage if the swarm or its allies are fighting it. Failure charms it. While conscious and on the same plane, the swarm can issue simple commands by telepathy without an action. If orders run out it protects itself. The swarm can spend an action for precise control through the end of its next turn and can spend its own reaction to direct the target’s reaction. Each time the target takes damage, another DC 13 Wisdom save can end the spell.

gm.title: HP threshold
lines: With its printed maximum of 36 HP, the swarm can cast at 19 HP or more. At 18 HP or less, use the smaller Bites damage.

gm.title: Encounter ecology
lines: The rats combine their memories and minds when they swarm and communicate as one. A rat separated from the swarm begins with Intelligence 15, loses 1 Intelligence per day to a minimum of 4, and returns to 15 when it rejoins any such swarm. Illithid colonies can receive a swarm’s reports within the elder brain’s telepathic range.

gm.title: Source notes
lines:
The swarm’s Telepathic Shroud covers all divination spells. The same block lists Detect Thoughts and Comprehend Languages, both self-range divinations, with no explicit self-cast exception. Both printed rules are retained.
The 2014 Command language and harmful-order restrictions still apply. Volo grants component-free casting and separately lists telepathy 30 ft.

lines: The King of Renardy, Duke of Ysembragne, Baron of Brégoigne, and Countess of Marmandy are known bearers. gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Legendary Resistance (3/Day). If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Magic Resistance. The tarrasque has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. Reflective Carapace. Any time the tarrasque is targeted by a magic missile spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a d6. On a 1 to 5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected, and the effect is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from the tarrasque, turning the caster into the target. Siege Monster. The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack. The tarrasque can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes five attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, one with its horns, and one with its tail. It can use its Swallow instead of its bite. Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the tarrasque can’t bite another target. Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) slashing damage. Horns. Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) piercing damage. Tail. Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. Frightful Presence. Each creature of the tarrasque’s choice within 120 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the tarrasque is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the tarrasque’s Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours. Swallow. The tarrasque makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite’s damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 (16d6) acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque’s turns. If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque. If the tarrasque dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting prone.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines: The tarrasque can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The tarrasque regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. Attack. The tarrasque makes one claw attack or tail attack. Move. The tarrasque moves up to half its speed. Chomp (Costs 2 Actions). The tarrasque makes one bite attack or uses its Swallow.

A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions and can’t teleport, it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 (16d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque’s turns. lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The tarrasque can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. The tarrasque has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Reflective Carapace. If targeted by Magic Missile, a line spell, or any spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll 1d6. The tarrasque is unaffected on every result. On a 6, it reflects the effect back at the caster, who becomes the target as if the tarrasque cast the spell.
Siege Monster. The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. The tarrasque may first use Frightful Presence. It then makes one Bite, two Claw attacks, one Horns attack, and one Tail attack. It can use Swallow in place of Bite.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 36 (4d12 + 10) piercing damage. A creature hit by it is Grappled (escape DC 20) and Restrained while that grapple lasts. The tarrasque cannot bite another target until the grapple ends.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 28 (4d8 + 10) slashing damage.
Horns. Melee weapon attack, +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 32 (4d10 + 10) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +19 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit 24 (4d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit by it falls Prone unless it succeeds on a DC 20 Strength save.
Frightful Presence. Choose any creatures within 120 ft. that are aware of the tarrasque. Each makes a DC 17 Wisdom save or is Frightened for 1 minute. A target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the tarrasque is within its line of sight. Success ends the effect. A creature that saves or whose fear ends is immune to this Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
Swallow. Make a Bite attack against a Large or smaller creature the tarrasque is grappling. A hit deals Bite damage, ends the grapple, and swallows it. A swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover from outside the tarrasque, and takes 56 (16d6) acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns. If a swallowed creature deals at least 60 damage to the tarrasque in a single turn, the tarrasque makes a DC 20 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure it regurgitates all swallowed creatures. They land Prone within 10 ft. of it. If the tarrasque dies, the restraint from swallowing ends. A swallowed creature can spend 30 ft. of movement to exit the corpse Prone.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

lines:

gm.title: Description
lines: A storm giant’s ritual near the Shadowfell leaves its soul bound to a cloud that rains hail and necrotic lightning.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold, necrotic, poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Incorporeal Movement. The spirit treats other creatures and objects as difficult terrain when moving through them. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The spirit can turn a failed saving throw into a success.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Lightning Fist and Hailstone.
Lightning Fist. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 25 (4d8 + 7) lightning damage.
Hailstone. Ranged weapon attack, +12 to hit, range 90/180 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.
Death Bolt (Recharge 5–6). Hurl magical lightning in a 120-ft. line 10 ft. wide. Each creature in the line makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 27 (6d8) lightning damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage. Success halves both. Either way, reduce the creature's HP maximum by the necrotic damage it takes. The reduction lasts until it finishes a long rest, and it dies if its maximum reaches 0.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Hailstorm (Recharge 4–6). Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each creature in a cylinder centered there, 20 ft. in radius and 40 ft. high, makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage and knocks the creature prone. Success halves both types of damage without knocking it prone.

gm.title: Description
lines: A second shadow follows its host by day. At night the outsider uses the sleeping host’s body to act on grudges that the host mistakes for dreams.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +3. AC +3 Dex, +2 deflection. Touch AC 15, flat-footed AC 12. Printed base attack +8, grapple +8. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +6, Ref +6, Will +6.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack and full attack. Use the host’s attacks.
Malevolent Possession (Su). Once a night, enter a sleeping creature on the Material Plane unless it passes a DC 20 Will save. Use magic jar at caster level 10 without a receptacle. It takes over the body and controls dreams as a 10th-level sorcerer using dream. A success grants immunity to its possession that night.
Wisdom Drain (Su). Once per night the possessed creature takes 1d4 Wisdom drain unless it passes a DC 29 Will save.
Spell-like abilities. Twice per day each: bane, charm person, command, confusion, crushing despair, mind fog, and undetectable alignment. Caster level 10, save DC 15 + spell level. Detect thoughts is listed separately without a specified frequency.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Incorporeal. It is dormant during the day and uses the host’s skills while in control at night. A DC 20 Spot check reveals the extra shadow. Otherwise, detection requires telepathic contact. Dispel evil or an ethereal opponent can drive it out of its host.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Bluff +12, Concentration +8, Diplomacy +12, Gather Information +12, Hide +20, Intimidate +10, Knowledge (the planes) +12, Listen +12, Sense Motive +12, Spot +12. Alertness, Blind-Fight, Combat Reflexes.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land or underground. Solitary, always neutral evil, no treasure. Advances to 9–12 HD (Medium). Printed level adjustment +7.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The special attacks line says “Will drain.” The detailed ability drains Wisdom and uses a Will save.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +3. AC 14 (+1 size, +3 Dex), touch 14, flat-footed 11. Base attack +0, grapple +4. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +3. Balance +6, Climb +10, Hide +8, Move Silently +5. Dodge, Weapon Finesse. Underground (Markovia). Group of 10–30. No treasure. Always neutral evil.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Tentacle +4 melee (1d3 plus paralysis).
Full attack. Two tentacles +4 melee (1d3 plus paralysis each) and bite −1 melee (1d4).
Paralysis (Ex). Each tentacle hit requires a DC 12 Fortitude save or the target is paralyzed for 1d6+2 minutes.

gm.title: Traits and tactics

gm.title: Description
lines: A spirit driven from its living body by possession. Bands of the dispossessed sometimes gather in an abandoned home and act out their former lives.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium disembodied spirit of a living creature. Alignment varies.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Uncommon in the Shadow World. Appears in bands of 1d20. Active any time. No diet. Average intelligence 8–10. Medium, about 6 ft. tall. Morale 15–16. No treasure, bloodline, blood abilities, or magic resistance.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Touch of despair. One attack for 1d4 damage plus despair. When the cumulative number of hits equals the target’s Constitution, its spirit leaves and becomes one of the dispossessed. The attacker immediately takes over the body. If the target survives, despair lingers for one day per hit. Each casting of remove fear shortens this by one day.

gm.title: Depression
lines: On first sight of any dispossessed spirit, save vs. paralyzation. On failure, movement is halved and attacks and Dexterity-based tasks suffer −3 or −25% while any dispossessed spirit remains within 100 yards. After leaving that range, the penalty falls to −1 or −10% for 4d6 hours plus one hour for each four hours of exposure. A character conversing with one saves again each turn.

gm.title: Defenses and behavior
lines: Requires a +1 or better weapon to hit. As spirits of still-living bodies, they do not respond to holy water, turning, or attacks specific to undead. They can speak and move small or medium objects psychically. Evil spirits seize chances to possess others. Any spirit has a 60% chance to mistake a character for its old body and focus on that character. Restoring it to its own body, or the death of that original body, puts it to rest. Taking a different body offers no lasting relief.

gm.title: Seeming
lines: Perception none, Seeming slight. Observers with low Perception can mistake them for corporeal people.

gm.title: Description
lines: The Grave Order made the Horror from five fallen adventurers and bound Elyas Leodeir’s unwilling soul to it.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saves Str +6, Con +5, Wis +1. Skill Intimidation +4. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 9. Understands Common and cannot speak.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Dying Gasp. When the Horror dies, the creature that reduced it to 0 HP can appeal to Elyas with a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check without spending an action. On a success, each enemy of the Grave Order within 30 ft. of the Horror gains 7 (2d6) temporary HP. On a failure or if nobody attempts the check, each creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 4 (1d8) acid damage and 4 (1d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Spine Cleaver. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) against a Grappled target.
Bone Hook. Ranged weapon attack +6, range 15 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14), and the Horror can pull it up to 15 ft. closer. The Horror cannot use Bone Hook against another target until this grapple ends.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Valor’s Death. Each enemy within 10 ft. who can hear the Horror must make a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened of the Horror for 1 minute and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition. A creature becomes immune to this Horror’s Valor’s Death for 24 hours when it succeeds on the save or the effect ends.

gm.title: Villain Party Action
lines:
Grave Order. Once per encounter for each party action, after an enemy finishes its turn. The party can use the actions in any order, one per round. The creature performing the action must be present and must not be Incapacitated.
Action 3, Threshing Flail. The Horror moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. When the movement ends, each enemy within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure, the enemy takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage and falls Prone. On a success, it takes half as much damage and stays upright.
