gm.title: Description
lines: This living storm is the second form of Goxomoc. Defeating it returns the titan to his resting place.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Saving throws Int +15, Wis +17. Arcana +15, History +15, Perception +17. Immune to lightning, poison, and thunder, to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks, and to Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Flanked, Frightened, Grappled, Poisoned, Paralyzed, Petrified, Restrained, and Stunned. Truesight 300 ft., passive Perception 27. Understands all languages but cannot speak. Telepathy 150 ft.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amorphous. Pass through a 1-inch opening without squeezing.
Discorporation. At 0 HP or death, end all conditions and other effects on him. He teleports to his resting place, returns to his Goxomoc form at full HP, and falls Unconscious.
Disruptive Resistance (3/day). Turn his failed save into a success. Lightning Aura shuts off until the end of his next turn.
Lightning Aura. A creature starting its turn within 60 ft. makes a DC 25 Dexterity save, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage or half on a success.
Power of the Storm. His lightning and thunder damage ignores resistance.
Siege Monster. He deals double damage to objects and structures.
Supernatural Resistance. He has advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Lightning Strike attacks.
Lightning Strike. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +19 to hit, 15-ft. reach or 600-ft. range, one target. Hit 29 (3d12 + 10) lightning damage. A second target within 30 ft. of the first takes the same damage on a failed DC 27 Dexterity save.
Energy Flow. Move up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks. He can pass through creature spaces without treating them as difficult terrain. Each creature takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage the first time he crosses its space during this move.
Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 90-ft. cone make DC 27 Dexterity saves. On a failure, take 71 (11d12) lightning damage and lose reactions until the end of their next turn. On a success, take half damage only.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Gone in a Flash. Teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space he sees, bringing anyone inside him. Each creature within 10 ft. of the space he left makes a DC 25 Constitution save, taking 22 (4d10) thunder damage or half on a success.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Shock Cage. When a creature he sees within 30 ft. hits him with an attack, that creature takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage and is Restrained until the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Thunderstruck. Creatures within 120 ft. that hear him make DC 25 Wisdom saves. Those who fail are Dazed for 1 minute and repeat the save at the end of their turns.
2. Into the Storm. Enemies he sees within 30 ft. make DC 25 Strength saves. On a success, they take 16 (3d10) lightning damage. On a failure, they are pulled inside him. There, they are Restrained, move with him, and have total cover from outside attacks and other effects. At the start of each of their turns they take 16 (3d10) lightning plus 16 (3d10) thunder damage. Each can escape into an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 ft. by using an action to pass a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. If he takes at least 60 damage in a single turn or falls to 0 HP, all trapped creatures are expelled to unoccupied spaces of their choice within 5 ft.
3. Behold True Power. Enemies within 120 ft. make DC 25 Strength saves. Failure deals 44 (8d10) lightning damage and moves them up to 60 ft. in any direction. A success halves the damage and keeps the target in place.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses one of these options: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, its turn ends. Extra actions from effects such as Haste and Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect can end this condition.

gm.title: Flanked (MCDM)
lines: If using flanking rules, creatures cannot flank this creature.

gm.title: Mundane Attacks (MCDM)
lines: A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: The Tyract is an armored vaurath with a massive central eye and eight detached psionic eyes.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saves Int +9, Wis +7, Cha +9. Arcana +9, Deception +9, Insight +7, Intimidation +9, Perception +7. Immune to Charmed, Flanked, Frightened and Prone. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 17. Common, Deep Speech and Undercommon.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Painful Resistance (3/day). After failing a save, Xorannox can succeed by destroying one of his eight floating eyes, chosen randomly with a d8. He grows a new eye to replace it 24 hours later.
Eyes Always Shielded. The eyes retain their psionic shields even after using Eye Psionics.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) piercing damage.
Eye Psionics. Use three different effects from the floating eyes. No effect can be used twice on the same turn. Except where an effect specifies otherwise, each targets one creature Xorannox can see within 120 ft.
Charm Beam. DC 17 Wisdom save or Charmed by Xorannox for 1 hour. The charm ends if he harms the target or one of the target’s allies.
Compulsion Beam. DC 17 Intelligence save or the target uses its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed toward its closest visible ally and make a weapon attack against that ally. Creatures immune to Charmed are unaffected.
Memory Beam. DC 17 Intelligence save. On a failure, the target expends an available spell slot of its highest remaining level with no effect. A target with no slots left loses proficiency with one weapon it holds or carries for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end that loss early.
Toxic Vapors. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. All creatures within 10 ft. of it make a DC 17 Constitution save or become Poisoned for 1 minute. Each affected creature repeats the save at the end of its own turn to end the effect early.
Telekinetic Field. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each enemy within 10 ft. of it makes a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure, Xorannox moves the enemy up to 30 ft. in any direction and deals 7 (2d6) force damage at the end of that movement. He can also move an object in the area up to 30 ft. in any direction if it weighs 300 pounds or less and is neither worn nor carried. He can manipulate the object precisely.
Lightning Bolt. Creatures in a 60-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, make a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
Explosion. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Creatures within 10 ft. of it make a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
Necrosis Beam. DC 17 Constitution save or the target takes 55 (10d10) necrotic damage immediately and loses 7 (2d6) HP at the start of each of its turns. A target reduced to 0 HP by this effect dies. The effect ends if Xorannox dies or loses sight of the target. He cannot use the beam again while that effect lasts.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: The Great Eye (Recharge 6). Xorannox projects a 150-ft. cone. For Xorannox and each creature in the cone affected by a spell, that spell’s effects end immediately for that creature.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Cower! When an attacker hits Xorannox, it makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and is Frightened of him for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Each option is available once per encounter after an enemy’s turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
Disruption Beams. Choose three visible creatures within 120 ft. Each makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage whenever it makes more than one weapon attack on a turn or casts a spell of 1st level or higher. The effect lasts 1 minute, and each affected creature repeats the save at the end of its own turn to end it early.
Disappearing Act. Xorannox becomes Invisible until the end of his next turn and teleports to a visible unoccupied space within 120 ft.
Megabeam. In a 120-ft. line, 20 ft. wide, each creature saves against two random Eye Psionics effects from Xorannox’s remaining eyes. Reroll duplicates for each creature. Effects that normally cover an area affect only that individual creature.

Each option is available once per encounter after an enemy’s turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
Disruption Beams. Choose three visible creatures within 120 ft. Each makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage whenever it makes more than one weapon attack on a turn or casts a spell of 1st level or higher. The effect lasts 1 minute, and each affected creature repeats the save at the end of its own turn to end it early.
Disappearing Act. Xorannox becomes Invisible until the end of his next turn and teleports to a visible unoccupied space within 120 ft.
Megabeam. In a 120-ft. line, 20 ft. wide, each creature saves against two random Eye Psionics effects from Xorannox’s remaining eyes. Reroll duplicates for each creature. Effects that normally cover an area affect only that individual creature.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: The White Tower, p. 150 (stat block), p. 142 (lair)

gm.title: Lair Actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one option. The same action cannot be used two rounds in a row.
Gas Belch. Choose a point on a floor, wall, or ceiling within 60 ft. A 20-ft. sphere of gas lasts through the end of initiative count 20 next round. A creature that enters it for the first time or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or be Poisoned until the start of its next turn.
Slime Shower. One enemy within 120 ft. makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure, it becomes vulnerable to fire and lightning damage until it takes either type of damage or initiative count 20 ends next round, whichever comes first.
Telekinetic Hold. Choose three enemies within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, the enemy’s speed becomes 0 and it rises straight up 20 ft. It falls at the end of initiative count 20 next round.

gm.title: Retreat
lines: At 60 HP, Xorannox ends the levitation affecting the library furniture and tries to escape through the egg pit at X9. Other creatures in X5 or X6 make a DC 17 Dexterity save against the falling furniture, taking 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Description
lines: Yagnoloths negotiate contracts for other yugoloths. They sign contracts with their smaller arm and use the other to fight.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Magic Resistance. The yagnoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Electrified Touch attack and one Massive Arm attack, or make one Massive Arm attack and use either Battlefield Cunning (if available) or Teleport.
Electrified Touch. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 27 (6d8) lightning damage.
Massive Arm. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (3d12 + 4) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must pass a DC 16 Constitution save or be stunned until the end of the yagnoloth's next turn.
Battlefield Cunning (Recharge 4–6). Up to two allied yugoloths within 60 ft. that can hear the yagnoloth can each use a reaction for one melee attack.
Life Leech. Touch one incapacitated creature within 15 ft. It takes 36 (7d8 + 4) necrotic damage, and the yagnoloth gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt. On a failed DC 16 Constitution save, the target's hit point maximum falls by half the necrotic damage it took. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. A creature whose maximum falls to 0 dies.
Teleport. The yagnoloth and any equipment it wears or carries teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.

lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 16). No material components are required.
At will. Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Invisibility (self only), Suggestion.
3/day. Lightning Bolt.

lines: A leather-armored goblin and ambitious second-in-command of Cragmaw Hideout.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Leather armor, shield. Skills Stealth +6. Senses: darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 9. Languages: Common, Goblin.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Nimble Escape. Take the Disengage or Hide action.

gm.title: Encounter
lines: Yeemik commands five other goblins in the den. When he starts losing, he holds Sildar Hallwinter, who has 1 HP, over the upper ledge. He offers a truce if the party kills Klarg and later demands ransom. If they refuse to parley, he pushes Sildar over the edge. The fall deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage and leaves Sildar at 0 HP.

gm.title: Description
lines: The demon lord known as the Beast of Butchery carries the Butcher, a three-headed flail he can summon to his hand. His lair, the Death Dells, is a hunting ground in the Abyss.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Poison. Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). If Yeenoghu fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed.
Magic Resistance. Yeenoghu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Flail attacks.
Flail. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (2d12 + 9) force damage. On his turn, Yeenoghu can add one effect to a hit. He can use each effect only once per turn.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) acid damage.

gm.title: Flail effects mechanics
lines:
Confusion. On a failed DC 17 Wisdom save, the target is affected by Confusion until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.
Force. The target takes 13 (2d12) extra force damage.
Paralysis. On a failed DC 17 Constitution save, the target is paralyzed until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 17). No material components are required.
At will. Detect Magic.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Fear, Invisibility.
1/day. Teleport.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Rampage. When Yeenoghu reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, he can move up to half his speed and make one Bite attack.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Yeenoghu has 3 legendary actions. Use one option, paying its listed cost, at the end of another creature's turn. He regains spent legendary actions at the start of his turn. He cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using them.
Charge (1 action). Move up to his speed.
Swat Away (1 action). Make one Flail attack. On a hit, the target must pass a DC 24 Strength save or be pushed up to 15 ft. straight away from Yeenoghu. If it fails by 5 or more, it also falls prone.
Savage (2 actions). Make a separate Bite attack against each creature within 10 ft.

gm.title: Lair
lines: When encountered in his lair in the Death Dells, Yeenoghu is CR 25 (75,000 XP).

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, after creatures tied on that count, Yeenoghu can choose one option. He cannot choose the same option two rounds in a row.
Incite the Pack. Until the next initiative count 20, gnolls and hyenas in the lair have advantage on melee weapon attack rolls, and attack rolls against them have advantage.
Iron Spike. An iron spike 5 ft. tall and 1 inch wide erupts from a point on the ground Yeenoghu can see within 100 ft. A creature in that space makes a DC 24 Dexterity save. On failure, it takes 27 (6d8) piercing damage and is restrained on the spike. A creature can use its action to free itself or another creature within reach, ending the restraint.
Pack Rush. Each gnoll or hyena Yeenoghu can see can use its reaction to move up to its speed.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or both effects around Yeenoghu’s lair.
Savage Predators. Predatory Beasts within 6 miles of the lair kill far more prey than they need and leave the carcasses to rot.
Spiky Terrain. Large iron spikes grow from the ground and stone surfaces within 1 mile of the lair. Yeenoghu mounts the bodies of his victims on them.
If Yeenoghu dies, these effects fade over 1d10 days.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 270.

gm.title: References
lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 270 · https://5e.tools/bestiary.html#yeenoghu_mpmm

gm.title: Description
lines: The Gnoll Lord hunts captives across the Death Dells with gnolls and hyenas. He calls his three-headed flail the Butcher and can summon it into his hand at will.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical sources.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
Yeenoghu uses Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks) and needs no material components.
At will. Detect Magic.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Fear, Invisibility.
1/day. Teleport.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Yeenoghu can choose to succeed on a failed saving throw.
Magic Resistance. He has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.
Rampage. After reducing a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on his turn, Yeenoghu can use a bonus action to move up to half his speed and make one Bite attack.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Flail attacks. After each hit, Yeenoghu may choose or roll for one extra effect below. Each effect can apply only once per Multiattack.
1. Deal another 13 (2d12) bludgeoning damage.
2. The target makes a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, it is paralyzed until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.
3. The target makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, it suffers the effects of Confusion until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.
Flail. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (1d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (1d10 + 9) piercing damage.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Yeenoghu has 3 legendary actions. He can use one option at the end of another creature's turn and recovers all spent actions at the start of his turn.
Charge (1 action). Move up to his speed.
Swat Away (1 action). Make one Flail attack. On a hit, the target makes a DC 24 Strength save. On a failure, it is pushed 15 ft. directly away from Yeenoghu. If the save fails by 5 or more, it also falls prone.
Savage (2 actions). Make a separate Bite attack against each creature within 10 ft.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing initiative ties, choose one effect. Yeenoghu cannot repeat the same effect in consecutive rounds.
Iron Spike. A spike 5 ft. tall and 1 inch wide rises from a point on the ground Yeenoghu can see within 100 ft. Each creature in that space makes a DC 24 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 27 (6d8) piercing damage and is restrained by the spike. A creature can use an action to pull itself or a creature it can reach off the spike, ending the restraint.
Pack Rush. Every gnoll or hyena Yeenoghu can see can use its reaction to move up to its speed.
Enrage the Pack. Until the next initiative count 20, all gnolls and hyenas in the lair have advantage on melee weapon attack rolls. Attack rolls against them also have advantage.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects around the lair.
Iron spikes grow from ground and stone within 1 mile. Yeenoghu uses them to display bodies.
Predatory beasts within 6 miles kill far more than they need to eat and leave the carcasses to rot.
A humanoid that spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile must pass a DC 17 Wisdom save or roll on the Madness of Yeenoghu table. A successful save grants 24 hours of immunity to this effect.
The effects fade over 1d10 days after Yeenoghu dies.

gm.title: Madness of Yeenoghu
lines:
Roll d100 when a creature goes mad in the lair or in Yeenoghu's line of sight. The resulting flaw lasts until cured.
01–20. Feeds on others' anger and tries to whip up a mob.
21–40. Craves the flesh of other intelligent creatures.
41–60. Rejects laws and customs in favor of a more primitive way of life.
61–80. Starts fights in the hope that someone will die.
81–100. Makes ornaments from trophies taken from the dead.

gm.title: Source notes
lines: Page 155 lists Constitution 23 with a +8 modifier and Intelligence 15 with a +3 modifier. Under the standard ability rules the scores yield +6 and +2. The printed scores, listed saving throws, and hit points are preserved here.

gm.title: Description
lines: An orchid-like vine that grows on statuary, gravestones, and other shaded surfaces. Its bright petals release an irresistible scent.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
False Appearance. A motionless creeper is indistinguishable from an ordinary flowering vine.
Regeneration. At the start of its turn the creeper recovers 10 HP. Taking fire, necrotic, or radiant damage disables this recovery at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts a turn at 0 HP and cannot regenerate.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Touch. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit for 13 (3d8) psychic damage. A humanoid reduced to 0 HP by the damage dies and receives a bulb. Unless the bulb is destroyed, the corpse becomes a Yellow Musk Zombie 24 hours after death. Raising the humanoid, casting Remove Curse on the corpse, or using similar magic destroys the bulb if done before it animates.
Yellow Musk (3/day). All humanoids within 30 ft. make a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure they are charmed for 1 minute and spend their turns moving as close to the creeper as they can, doing nothing else. They can repeat the save at the end of each turn to end the effect.

gm.title: Hosts
lines: The vine controls the zombie it animates. In seven days the new creeper grows to full size and emerges from the host, which collapses. If the zombie is destroyed first, the young plant withers and dies. A Small host produces a Small zombie with 27 (6d6 + 6) HP, otherwise using the Yellow Musk Zombie's statistics.

gm.title: Wilderness encounter
lines: Place the creeper deep in a ruin and give it 3d6 Yellow Musk Zombies, scattered or clustered to suit the terrain. At camp, the zombies emerge from a nearby ruin and try to knock the characters unconscious and drag them to the plant.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Tomb of Annihilation, p. 237 for the stat block and host procedure, p. 203 for the random encounter.

gm.title: Description
lines: A creeper animates this corpse from within. The host moves just enough to guard the young vine until it can leave.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Undead Fortitude. When damage reduces the zombie to 0 HP, it makes a Constitution saving throw with a DC equal to 5 + the damage taken. On a success it drops to 1 HP instead. Fire damage and critical hits bypass this save.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Slam. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Small variant
lines: A transformed Small humanoid becomes a Small undead with 27 HP (6d6 + 6). Keep the rest of the statistics.

gm.title: Host and creeper
lines: An implanted bulb animates the corpse after 24 hours. The zombie protects the growing Yellow Musk Creeper and feeds it. After seven days the mature creeper breaks free and the host collapses. If the zombie is destroyed first, the immature creeper dies with it.

gm.title: Description
lines: Powerful Fey grant packs of yeth hounds to their favorites. The hounds run their prey down at night and flee the daylight.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but cannot speak.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Sunlight Banishment. If the hound starts its turn in sunlight, it moves to the Deep Ethereal and must stay there while sunlight falls on the spot it left. After sunset it returns to that spot on the Border Ethereal. The hound and creatures on the Material Plane can see one another across the border but cannot affect one another. Once the hound is adjacent to its master or a pack mate on the Material Plane, it can use an action to return to that plane.
Telepathic Bond. While the hound and its master are on the same plane, they can communicate telepathically and the hound can magically share what it senses.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. A frightened target also takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage.
Baleful Baying. The hound bays magically. Each enemy within 300 ft. that hears it must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or be frightened of the hound until the end of the hound's next turn or until the hound is incapacitated. A creature frightened this way that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the hound must use all its movement before acting, taking the most direct route to get as far away as possible even through hazards. A creature that succeeds on the save is immune to every yeth hound's baying for 24 hours.

gm.title: Description
lines: A flying fey hound with a humanlike face and a bay that drives prey into the dark. Its pack hunts for a master and retreats to its den before dawn.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Common, Elvish and Sylvan but cannot speak.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Keen Hearing and Smell. The hound has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
Sunlight Banishment. Starting its turn in sunlight sends the hound to the Deep Ethereal. It stays there while sunlight reaches the spot it left. After sunset it reappears at that spot in the Border Ethereal. It and creatures on the Material Plane can see one another across the boundary but cannot affect one another.
Telepathic Bond. When the hound and its master share a plane, the hound can magically relay what it senses and they can communicate telepathically.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage and an additional 14 (4d6) psychic damage if the target is frightened.
Baleful Baying. Each enemy that can hear the magical bay within 300 ft. must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or be frightened through the end of the hound's next turn. The effect ends early if the hound becomes incapacitated. An affected creature starting its turn within 30 ft. of the hound must spend all its movement getting as far away as possible by the most direct route, even through hazards, before taking an action. A creature that passes the save is immune to all yeth hounds' baying for 24 hours.
Return to the Material Plane (Sunlight Banishment). While in the Border Ethereal, the hound can use its action to return when adjacent to its master or a pack mate on the Material Plane.

gm.title: Description
lines: A white-furred alpine hunter that tracks prey by scent and blends in with snow. Its gaze can freeze a victim in place.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fear of Fire. If the yeti takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
Keen Smell. The yeti has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on smell.
Snow Camouflage. The yeti has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in snowy terrain.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. The yeti makes two Claw attacks and can also use Chilling Gaze.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.
Chilling Gaze. Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. If it can see the yeti, it makes a DC 13 Constitution save against this magic. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) cold damage and becomes Paralyzed for 1 minute. Cold immunity prevents both effects. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect on a success. If it succeeds on a save or the effect on it ends, it is immune to the Chilling Gaze of all normal yetis for 1 hour. The hour of immunity does not apply to abominable yetis.

Ice Throw. Ranged attack, +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: In its demon form, a pillar of yellow slime with one eye and flailing tentacles. It can resemble a drow or a giant spider.

gm.title: Defenses
lines: Resists cold, fire, lightning, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Immune to poison damage and Poisoned.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Shapechanger. As an action it can become a female drow, a giant spider, or return to its demon form. It keeps the same statistics and its gear keeps its shape. It returns to its true form on death.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
Web Walker. Webbing doesn’t restrict its movement.

gm.title: Innate spellcasting
lines:
Charisma, save DC 14. These spells require no material components.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Web.
1/day. Dominate Person.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Slam (Bite in spider form). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or 10 ft. in demon form, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or piercing in spider form, plus 21 (6d6) poison damage.
Mist Form. It and its gear become toxic mist until it returns to its true form. It reverts on death. In mist form it is Incapacitated and cannot speak. It can hover, fly 30 ft., and pass through any gap that isn’t airtight. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saves and is immune to nonmagical damage. It can enter and stop in a creature’s space. Each time that creature starts its turn sharing the space, it makes a DC 14 Constitution save or is Poisoned until its next turn starts. It remains Incapacitated while Poisoned in this way.

gm.title: Optional summoning

gm.title: Description
lines: Chief Yorb is a gold-skinned grung who rides a trained hadrosaurus at Nangnang’s shrine. He is wary of strangers and has yet to learn that his favored son is missing.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. Yorb breathes air and water.
Poisonous Skin. A creature that grapples Yorb or touches his skin makes a DC 12 Constitution save or is poisoned for 1 minute. Once contact has ended, it can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on a success.
Standing Leap. Yorb can long jump up to 25 ft. and high jump up to 15 ft. without a running start.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 12 Constitution save or takes an extra 5 (2d4) poison damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 12 Constitution save or takes an extra 5 (2d4) poison damage.
Mesmerizing Chirr (recharge 6). Each humanoid or beast within 15 ft. that can hear Yorb makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or is stunned until the end of Yorb’s next turn. Grungs are immune.

gm.title: Optional gold grung poison
lines: If using the optional Volo’s Guide to Monsters poison variant, a creature poisoned by Yorb is also charmed and can speak Grung while poisoned. The poison loses potency 1 minute after removal from a grung or after the grung dies.

gm.title: Nangnang’s shrine
lines: Four orange Grung Elite Warriors stay with Yorb and his Hadrosaurus in the flooded courtyard. A red Grung Wildling and seven green Grungs hold the roof. If intruders fight back, 1d4 more green grungs arrive at the end of each round, up to twenty. If losing, Yorb and his elite guards retreat into the shrine and bar the doors. Forcing those doors takes a successful DC 25 Strength check. He will talk if the characters rescue his son and can communicate with him.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Tomb of Annihilation, ch. 3, pp. 108–109 (area 18A), and appendix D, p. 223 (Grung Elite Warrior). The optional poison rule is from Volo’s Guide to Monsters, p. 156.

lines: This dragon carries a corruption that can turn her victims into gibbering mouthers.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saving throws Con +14, Wis +10, Cha +11. Arcana +13, Deception +11, Insight +17, Perception +17, Persuasion +11, Stealth +7. Immune to poison and psychic damage and to Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, and Stunned. Blindsight 120 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 27. Speaks Common, Deep Speech, and Draconic.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Corruption. Her poison damage ignores resistance and treats immunity as resistance. A creature other than a Construct or Undead that takes poison damage from her makes a DC 19 Constitution save. If it fails, it becomes corrupted and takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage at the start of each turn. It can repeat the save at the end of each turn. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or a comparable supernatural effect also ends the corruption. If the victim dies while corrupted, its body becomes a gibbering mouther under her control.
Withering Resistance (3/day). Take 16 (3d10) necrotic damage to turn her failed save into a success.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, 15-ft. reach, one target. Hit 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing plus 11 (2d10) poison damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 16 (2d6 + 9) slashing damage. She can move the target up to 15 ft. horizontally.
Corrupting Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 90-ft. cone make DC 22 Constitution saves. A creature that fails takes 56 (16d6) poison damage and is Poisoned until the end of its next turn. A success halves the damage and avoids the condition.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Ulcerate. One creature she sees within 60 ft. that is corrupted by her trait is Dazed until the end of its next turn on a failed DC 19 Constitution save.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Eldritch Disruption. When a creature she sees within 60 ft. hits her with an attack or passes a save, it chooses to take 10 (3d6) psychic damage or reroll the attack or save and use the new result.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Summon Monoliths. Create three crystal columns centered on points she sees within 500 ft. Each is a 10-ft.-radius, 60-ft.-high cylinder with AC 19, 100 HP, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. They do not block Yserthrax's vision. Creatures other than Yserthrax are vulnerable to psychic damage within 10 ft. of a column. When one is destroyed, creatures within 30 ft. make DC 19 Wisdom saves, taking 21 (6d6) psychic damage or half on a success.
2. Spatial Alteration. Creatures within 60 ft. make DC 19 Charisma saves. Those who fail are teleported up to 120 ft. to unoccupied spaces she sees.
3. Elder Scream. Each enemy she sees within 120 ft. makes a DC 19 Wisdom save, taking 77 (14d10) psychic damage or half on a success.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses one of these options: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, its turn ends. Extra actions from effects such as Haste and Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect can end this condition.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 40 ft., climb 30 ft., swim 30 ft.

gm.title: Description
lines: A six-headed yuan-ti that gained this form through a ritual in pursuit of godhood. It expects obedience from lesser yuan-ti and can take the shape of an enormous constrictor.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Magic Resistance. The anathema has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Ophidiophobia Aura. When a creature of the anathema’s choice starts its turn within 30 ft. of it and can see or hear it, the creature must make a DC 17 Wisdom save or become frightened of snakes and yuan-ti. Snakes and yuan-ti are exempt. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Success on the save or the end of the effect grants immunity to this aura for 24 hours.
Six Heads. The anathema has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saves against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned or knocked unconscious.
Shapechanger. The anathema can use its action to become a Huge giant constrictor snake or return to its true form. Its statistics remain the same. Worn and carried gear stays unchanged.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
Anathema form only. Charisma is the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17). No material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
3/day each. Darkness, Entangle, Fear, Haste, Suggestion, Polymorph.
1/day. Divine Word.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack (anathema form only). Make two Claw attacks, one Constrict attack and one Flurry of Bites attack.
Claw (anathema form only). Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. A hit deals 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning and 7 (2d6) acid damage and grapples the target (escape DC 16). The grappled target is restrained and takes both damage amounts again at the start of each of its own turns until the grapple ends. The anathema can constrict only one target at a time.
Flurry of Bites. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 27 (6d6 + 6) piercing and 14 (4d6) poison damage.

gm.title: Optional variant traits
lines:
Apply one or more of these options if you use the p. 98 variant rules.
Acid Slime (bonus action). The anathema coats itself in acid for 1 minute. A creature takes 5 (1d10) acid damage if it touches the anathema, hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft. or is hit by its Constrict.
Chameleon Skin. The anathema has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
Shed Skin (1/day, bonus action). The anathema sheds its skin to escape a grapple, shackles or another restraint. Eating the shed skin over 1 minute restores hit points equal to half its maximum.

lines: Yuan-ti brew a potion that turns captive humanoids into scaly guards for their eggs and settlements.

gm.title: Making a Broodguard
lines: The magical potion immediately incapacitates a captive humanoid and transforms it into a broodguard in 1d6 + 6 days. A creature forced to drink can attempt a DC 15 Constitution save. On a success, it takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and suffers no other effect. Lesser Restoration or Remove Curse can stop an ongoing transformation. Once it finishes, only Wish can reverse it.

gm.title: Description
lines: Nightmare speakers feed their victims' fears to Dendar the Night Serpent. They interpret the visions Dendar sends as prophecies and act to make them come true.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness does not impede this yuan-ti's darkvision.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Constrict and one Scimitar attack, or make two Spectral Fangs attacks.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature is grappled (escape DC 14) and restrained until the grapple ends. The yuan-ti can constrict only one creature at a time.
Scimitar (Yuan-ti Form Only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Spectral Fangs. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (3d8 + 3) necrotic damage.
Invoke Nightmare (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. Create an immobile illusion of its deepest fear that only it can see. On a failed DC 13 Intelligence save, it takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage and is frightened of the illusion, believing it is real. The yuan-ti concentrates as if on a spell for up to 1 minute, and the illusion cannot be damaged. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the illusion on a success or taking 11 (2d10) psychic damage on a failure.

gm.title: Description
lines: Omu’s exiled queen dwells in Nangalore. Feathered veils hide her face, and her tinctures let her see her long-dead consort, Thiru-Taya.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Petrifying Gaze. When a creature that can see Zalkoré’s eyes starts its turn within 30 ft. of her, she can call for a DC 14 Constitution save if she can see it and is not incapacitated. On a failure by 5 or more, the creature is petrified immediately. Any smaller failure leaves it restrained. A creature restrained this way repeats the save at the end of its next turn. Success ends the effect. On a failure, the creature is petrified. Greater Restoration or similar magic ends the petrification.
A creature that is not surprised can avert its eyes at the start of its turn. It then cannot see Zalkoré until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. Looking at her sooner forces an immediate save. If she sees her reflection on a polished surface within 30 ft. in bright light, her own gaze affects her.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Snake Hair and two Shortsword attacks, or make two Longbow attacks.
Snake Hair. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

gm.title: Nangalore
lines: Zalkoré can describe Omu’s location and the yuan-ti interest in the city. She wants a gem, piece of jewelry, or art worth at least 500 gp for her Black Orchid, which Asharra needs for a ritual. She also accepts a character with Charisma 16 or higher as a slave in trade. Disturbing Thiru-Taya’s ashes or statue, repeatedly disparaging him, pulling the veil away, taking the orchid, or bringing out a mirror can turn the encounter violent.

gm.title: Poisoned hospitality
lines: Zalkoré can ring for an Eblis to bring tainted fruit and wine. Spotting the contamination requires proficiency in Medicine and a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Medicine) check. A creature that eats or drinks makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is poisoned for 1 hour or until it drinks 2 quarts of water. Zalkoré has built up a tolerance to this dose.

gm.title: Thiru-Taya
lines: At 63 HP or fewer, Zalkoré calls on Thiru-Taya’s apparition. It cannot be harmed, turned, controlled, or affected by spells. It remains until she dies or returns to full HP. Once per turn, when a creature within 15 ft. of her damages her, the apparition automatically deals 15 (2d8 + 6) force damage to that attacker with its spear.

gm.title: Dreaming tincture
lines: The lair holds 2d6 single-dose vials worth 10 gp each in Port Nyanzaru. A drinker makes a DC 15 Constitution save, succeeding automatically if immune to the poisoned condition. Failure causes convincing sensory hallucinations for 1d4 + 4 hours. Lesser Restoration or similar magic ends them early.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Tomb of Annihilation, ch. 2, pp. 79–80 (Nangalore, area 8), using the Medusa from Monster Manual (2014), p. 214.

gm.title: Description
lines: Summoning this elemental from the Plane of Earth raises the ground into an armored reptile. Its steps can level buildings, and it can draw into its shell to recover.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/Day). When it fails a saving throw, the zaratan can choose to succeed instead.
Siege Monster. It deals double damage to objects and structures. Earth-Shaking Movement already includes this increase.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Stomp attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (4d8 + 10) force damage.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 26 (3d10 + 10) thunder damage.
Spit Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +17 to hit, range 120/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 31 (6d8 + 10) force damage.
Spew Debris (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. cube makes a DC 25 Dexterity save, taking 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more is also knocked prone.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Earth-Shaking Movement. After moving at least 10 ft. on the ground, the zaratan creates a shock wave across a 120-ft.-radius circle centered on itself. That ground is difficult terrain for 1 minute. Each concentrating creature on the ground there loses concentration unless it passes a DC 25 Constitution save. Structures touching the ground in the area take 100 thunder damage. A creature within half the height of a collapsing structure makes a DC 25 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 17 (5d6) bludgeoning damage, falls prone, and is trapped and restrained in the rubble. A successful save halves the damage and avoids the collapse’s prone and restrained effects. A buried creature can use an action to escape with a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. An adjacent helper within 5 ft. can spend an action clearing debris to grant advantage on the check. With three helpers spending their actions, the check succeeds automatically.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The zaratan has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn, spending the listed action cost. Spent legendary actions return at the start of the creature's turn. A creature cannot use these actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using them.
Stomp (1 Action). Make one Stomp attack.
Move (1 Action). Move up to its speed.
Spit (2 Actions). Make one Spit Rock attack.
Retract (2 Actions). Withdraw into its shell. Until it emerges, the zaratan is restrained and has resistance to all damage. Its next legendary action must be Revitalize or Emerge.
Revitalize (2 Actions). Only while retracted, regain 52 (5d20) HP. The next legendary action must be Emerge.
Emerge (2 Actions). Only while retracted, leave the shell and make one Spit Rock attack.

gm.title: Description
lines: Once an angel assigned to watch the Blood War, Zariel fell and accepted Asmodeus's offer to rule Avernus. She bargains for the souls of practiced warriors to replenish her legions.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold, fire, radiant. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness does not impede Zariel's darkvision.
Legendary Resistance (3/Day). When Zariel fails a save, she can choose to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. She has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Zariel recovers 20 HP at the start of her turn. Radiant damage prevents this recovery at the start of her next turn. She dies only if she begins her turn at 0 HP and does not regenerate.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Flail or Longsword in any combination. Replace one attack with Horrid Touch if available.
Flail. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d8 + 8) force damage plus 36 (8d8) fire damage.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d8 + 8) radiant damage, or 19 (2d10 + 8) radiant damage with two hands, plus 36 (8d8) fire damage in either case.
Horrid Touch (Recharge 5–6). Touch one creature within 10 ft. On a failed DC 26 Constitution save, it takes 44 (8d10) necrotic damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned this way, it is also blinded and deafened. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Teleport. Zariel and her equipment teleport up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space she can see.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Cast one listed spell as an action, using Charisma (spell save DC 26) and omitting material components.
At will. Alter Self (Zariel may become Medium when changing her appearance), Detect Evil and Good, Fireball, Invisibility (self only), Major Image, Wall of Fire.
3/day each. Blade Barrier, Dispel Evil and Good, Finger of Death.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Zariel has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn, spending the listed action cost. Spent legendary actions return at the start of the creature's turn. A creature cannot use these actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using them.
Teleport (1 Action). Use Teleport.
Immolating Gaze (2 Actions). Choose one visible creature within 120 ft. It must pass a DC 26 Wisdom save or take 22 (4d10) fire damage.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
Zariel can choose one of the following options at initiative count 20, losing ties. An option cannot be used in consecutive rounds.
Fireball. Cast Fireball.
Infernal Illusions. Cast Major Image four times in different areas without concentration. All four illusions end at initiative count 20 of the next round. Each creature that can see these illusions must pass a DC 26 Wisdom save or be frightened of the illusion for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects around Zariel's basalt citadel in Avernus.
Hellscape. Screams and the smell of burning meat fill the area within 9 miles of the lair.
Pyres. Within 1 mile, jets of flame 10 ft. high rise every 60 ft. A creature or object touching a flame takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at most once per round.
Smoke. From 500 ft. out to 2 miles, persistent smoke heavily obscures the area and cannot be dispersed.
After Zariel dies, the effects fade over 1d10 days.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Zariel has 3 legendary actions. She can use one option at the end of another creature's turn and recovers all spent actions at the start of her turn.
Immolating Gaze (2 actions). One creature Zariel can see within 120 ft. makes a DC 26 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) fire damage.
Teleport (1 action). Use Teleport.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing initiative ties, choose one option. Zariel cannot repeat the same option in consecutive rounds.
Illusions. Cast Major Image four times at its lowest level in different areas. Zariel need not concentrate and the images disappear at initiative count 20 of the next round. Each creature that sees the illusions makes a DC 26 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened of the illusion for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the fear on a success.
Fireball. Cast her innate Fireball.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects around the lair.
Screams and the smell of burning meat fill the area within 9 miles.
Within 1 mile, a 10-ft.-high burst of flame rises every 60 ft. Touching a flame deals 7 (2d6) fire damage to a creature or object, at most once per round.
Smoke heavily obscures the area from 500 ft. to 2 miles from the lair. The smoke cannot be dispersed.
The effects fade over 1d10 days after Zariel dies.

gm.title: Source notes
lines: Page 180 gives Horrid Touch an attack roll and allows a repeat saving throw, but leaves out the save's ability and DC. Use DC 26 Constitution for the end-of-turn save, borrowing those values from Zariel's later Monsters of the Multiverse profile. The printed attack and on-hit damage still apply.

gm.title: Description
lines: The Simic Combine’s Prime Speaker defends the guild’s traditions and keeps her post with the support of the Speakers’ Chamber.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. Zegana breathes air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). She can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. She has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Zegana is a 15th-level Simic spellcaster with prepared wizard spells. Intelligence sets spell save DC 18 and +10 to hit with spell attacks.
Cantrips (at will). Acid Splash, Druidcraft, Ray of Frost, Shape Water.
1st level (4 slots). Color Spray, Expeditious Retreat, Fog Cloud, Shield.
2nd level (3 slots). Enlarge/Reduce, Gust of Wind.
3rd level (3 slots). Counterspell, Fly, Slow.
4th level (3 slots). Control Water, Ice Storm, Polymorph.
5th level (2 slots). Conjure Elemental, Creation.
6th level (1 slot). Move Earth, Wall of Ice.
7th level (1 slot). Prismatic Spray, Teleport.
8th level (1 slot). Control Weather, Dominate Monster.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Prime Speaker’s Trident. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage and the trident booms. Each creature in a 15-ft. cube from its prongs makes a DC 18 Constitution save. Failure deals 9 (2d8) thunder damage, or 13 (3d8) to a creature underwater, and pushes the creature 10 ft. away from Zegana. Success halves the thunder damage and prevents the push.
Deluge (Recharge 4–6). Send a wave to an area within 120 ft., up to 30 ft. long, 10 ft. wide, and 10 ft. high. Each creature there makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and knocks it prone. Success halves the damage and prevents the knockdown. The water puts out unprotected flames it touches before vanishing.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The creature can spend up to three legendary actions, choosing one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.
Adaptive Skin (1 action). Gain resistance to acid, fire, lightning, or thunder damage until her next turn starts.
Trident (1 action). Make one melee attack with the Prime Speaker’s Trident.
Enlarge (2 actions). Cast Enlarge/Reduce on herself using Enlarge without spending a spell slot.
Deluge (3 actions). Use Deluge if available.

gm.title: Roleplaying
lines: Zegana treats nature’s patterns as a guide for improving life. She commits her resources to Ravnica and struggles to understand anyone who rejects progress. See p. 254.

gm.title: Description
lines: Aastrika rose through the Sunlight Legion and leads fire giants into battle.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +11, Dex +7, Con +10, Wis +10. Athletics +11, Perception +10, Persuasion +6. Immune to fire damage and to Charmed and Frightened. Passive Perception 20. Speaks Giant and Primordial.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Battle Tranquility (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success. Aastrika cannot use Sweltering Heat until the end of her next turn.
Molten Flesh. The first time each turn a creature other than a fire giant touches her or hits her with a melee attack, it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Take the Disengage action and make up to three attacks in any combination of Unarmed Strike and Hurl Flame.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 21 (4d6 + 7) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature, attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of Aastrika's next turn while it glows red.
Hurl Flame. Ranged spell attack, +10 to hit, 180-ft. range, one target. Hit 20 (4d6 + 6) fire damage.
Lava Pillar (recharge 5–6). Pick a point she sees on the ground within 120 ft. Each creature in a 20-ft.-radius, 60-ft.-high cylinder above it makes a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 38 (11d6) fire damage or half on a success.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Sweltering Heat. Creatures within 20 ft. that lack resistance and immunity to fire damage gain one level of Exhaustion on a failed DC 18 Constitution save.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Power of Flame. When another fire giant she sees within 60 ft. misses a weapon attack, the giant rolls the damage as if it hit. The target takes half the result as fire damage.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Forward! Aastrika and up to three creatures she sees can each move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks and make one melee attack.
2. The Manifold Self. Teleport to an unoccupied space she sees within 30 ft. Five fire giant troopers appear in open spaces within 30 ft. of her departure point. They act immediately, then use that same initiative count in subsequent rounds.
3. This. Ends. Now. Aastrika and each willing fire giant within 60 ft. release heat. A creature within 10 ft. of her or one of those giants makes a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 55 (10d10) fire damage or half on a success.

Weakening Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, it has disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saves for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns it can repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Dragon Wings. On his turn, Zindar can sprout wings as a bonus action and gain a fly speed of 30 ft. He can dismiss them with another bonus action.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Zindar casts as a 14th-level sorcerer using Charisma. Spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks.
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt, Friends, Light, Mage Hand, Mending, Message.
1st level (6 slots). Magic Missile, Shield, Sleep.
2nd level (4 slots). Detect Thoughts, Knock.
3rd level (3 slots). Clairvoyance, Tongues.
4th level (3 slots). Dominate Beast, Stoneskin.
5th level (3 slots). Hold Monster, Telekinesis.
6th level (1 slot). True Seeing.
7th level (1 slot). Fire Storm.

gm.title: Encounter context
lines: Zindar is secretly part of the Ytepka Society. Messages left at his office receive a reply in 1d6 hours. He offers 2,000 gp for each pirate ship brought back to port and 500 gp more for each captured captain. The targets are the Dragonfang, the Emerald Eye, and the Stirge. Zhanthi funds the bounty and has privately uncovered evidence of Liara Portyr's arrangement with the pirates.

gm.title: Description
lines: A silent, hovering figure with an obsidian exoskeleton and two narrow eye slits. A zodar weighs about 1,500 pounds and may spend its life pursuing a purpose it never explains.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, petrified, poisoned.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Disembodied Voice. On at most three occasions in its life, the zodar can make the surrounding air deliver a message of up to 25 words. It reserves this for matters of great importance. A creature with Intelligence 2 or higher understands the message.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the zodar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed.
Transport Inhibitor. No effect can teleport the zodar or take it to another plane against its will.
Unusual Nature. The zodar needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Crushing Fist attacks. Use Forced Teleport either before both attacks or after both.
Crushing Fist. Make a +15 melee weapon attack against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 21 (2d10 + 10) force damage.
Forced Teleport. Choose one creature the zodar can see within 60 ft. It makes a DC 21 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) force damage, and the zodar moves it and its worn or carried gear up to 60 ft. by magic. The destination must be visible to the zodar, unoccupied, and able to support the target. On a success, the target takes half damage and stays in place.
Wish. Cast Wish using Charisma (spell save DC 17) without components. After the spell is cast, the zodar crumbles into dust and is destroyed.

gm.title: Description
lines: This green-lit fog drifts over graves after dark. Its cadavers draw attention away from the cloud itself, which feeds on the dying.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Any land. Solitary. Always neutral evil. No treasure. Advancement 7–12 HD (Colossal). It does not communicate.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative −2. AC −2 Dex, −8 size, and +12 deflection. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. No base attack or grapple listed. Printed space 60 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +5.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
DR 15/magic, SR 12, and undead traits. The cloud fills an area 25 ft. square and 10 ft. deep per HD.
Vaporous (Ex). Passes through tiny cracks, makes no movement noise, cannot enter liquids, and automatically fails saves against damaging air or wind effects. The cloud gives concealment at 5 ft. and total concealment beyond 5 ft. Its cadavers can see through it.
Unnatural Aura (Su). Animals refuse to approach within 30 ft. and panic while inside that range if forced to enter.
Daylight Powerlessness (Ex). In natural sunlight the fog hangs motionless and its cadavers drop lifeless until sundown. A daylight spell does not have this effect.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Animate Cadaver (Su). Animate humanoid corpses inside the cloud, even buried corpses unless blessed at burial or interred in sanctified ground. Raise up to 10 per round, including previously defeated cadavers at full HP. The number active at once cannot exceed the fog’s current HP.
Despair (Su). A creature that sees the fog makes a DC 13 Fear save or stays shaken until it has spent 10 minutes completely out of sight. Whatever the result, that fog cannot affect it with despair again for one day.
Life Drain (Su). A creature at negative HP in the cloud loses 1 additional HP each round, even after stabilizing. The drain stops at 0 HP or higher. Protection from evil prevents it.

gm.title: Fog cadaver
lines:
Medium Undead, CR 1/2. 2d12 + 3 (16 HP), initiative −1, speed 20 ft. (4 squares). AC 10 (−1 Dex, +1 natural), touch 9, flat-footed 10. Base attack and grapple are unlisted. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +0, Ref −1, Will +3. Str 11, Dex 9, Wis 10, Cha 1. Toughness, +4 turn resistance, undead traits. Always neutral, no treasure. The printed mob is 9–73.
Attack or full attack. Slam +1 melee for 1d6. The cadaver can move or attack in a round, doing both only as part of a charge. Dreadful Moan (Ex) requires a DC 12 Fear save within 10 ft. Cadavers collapse if taken out of the fog or exposed to natural sunlight.

gm.title: Feeding and advancement
lines: If fewer creatures die in it during a week than its current HD, it loses 1 HD. If at least twice its HD die inside it during a week, it gains 1 HD.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: For the 6-HD fog, use the printed 60-ft. combat space and the description’s per-HD coverage for situational extent. A printed mob can exceed the sample fog’s 42-cadaver cap, so use current HP to determine how many the individual fog controls.
The cadaver’s moan gives a Fear save without a special failure effect or a repeat interval. Use the normal Ravenloft Fear result for the failed save.

gm.title: Description
lines: Azalin’s lumbering construct is stitched from several ruined zombies. Its smell reaches intruders well before its fists do.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative −1. AC 17 (−1 size, −1 Dex, +9 natural). Derived touch AC 8 and flat-footed AC 17. Base attack +12, grapple +16. Printed space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +6, Ref +5, Will +6.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Slam +16 melee for 2d8 + 4 damage.
Standard Actions Only (Ex). Move or attack on a turn, or combine them as a charge. The chart separately lists a full attack of two slams at +16 for 2d8 + 4 each.
Stench (Ex). Coming within 30 ft. requires a DC 19 Fortitude save. Failure applies a −2 circumstance penalty to attacks, saves and skill checks for 1d6 + 4 minutes. Success grants immunity to this golem’s stench for one day.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Construct traits, damage reduction 10/magic. Magic Immunity (Ex) blocks spells, spell-like abilities and supernatural effects, with the listed exceptions. Targeted dispel magic with a check of at least 16 shuts it down for a number of rounds equal to the check result minus 10. A result of 26 or higher destroys it. Detect magic shows a growing magical aura while it is down. True resurrection destroys it immediately. Animate dead restores it to full HP.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land or underground. Solitary, always neutral, no treasure. Advancement 19–24 HD (Large) or 25–44 HD (Huge). A creator can command it within 60 ft. if it both sees and hears the creator. Otherwise it follows the last order and responds if attacked.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The source shows a two-slam full attack but separately restricts it to standard actions. Use a single slam unless another effect explicitly allows a full attack. Space and reach remain as printed despite the Large size.

gm.title: Description
lines: This decaying spellcaster directs other zombies from a distance and sees through their eyes. The sample is a 6th-level human adept with a toad familiar.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Any land. Solitary. Usually neutral evil. Standard treasure. Advances by character class.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +2. AC +2 Dex, +4 natural, and +2 leather armor. Touch 12, flat-footed 16. Base attack +3, grapple +5. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +8.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Concentration +7, Knowledge (arcana) +7, Knowledge (nature) +7, Listen +5, Profession (herbalist) +8, Spot +5, Search +3, Survival +12. Alertness, Brew Potion, Scribe Scroll, Toughness, Track.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Undead traits and toad familiar.
Aura of Death (Su). In the first round a living creature comes within 90 ft., it makes a DC 12 Fortitude save. Failure imposes a disease chosen by the zombie lord as contagion. A save failed by more than 10 kills the target and raises it as a zombie under the lord’s control. The lord cannot suppress the aura.
Speech of the Dead (Su). Speak telepathically with undead, which usually only report basic facts about their former lives and recent experiences. Use speak with dead at will by touching a corpse as a standard action.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Slam +5 melee for 1d8 + 2. Full attack makes two such slams or a sling attack +5 ranged for 1d4.
Zombie Master (Su). Command zombies in sight mentally as a free action at will. The lord can see or otherwise sense through any zombie within a mile.
Awaken the Dead (Su). Use animate dead at caster level 12 to create zombies only.
Zombify (Su). On a successful touch attack against a living creature, a failed DC 12 Fortitude save kills the target. It rises after 1d4 rounds as a controlled zombie. Awaken the Dead and Zombify share one use per day.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines: Adept divine slots 4/3/2 for spell levels 0–2. Save DC 13 + spell level. The source leaves spell preparation to the DM.

gm.title: Adapting the encounter
lines: Apply to a humanoid or monstrous humanoid base. Its type becomes undead, Hit Dice become d12, and natural armor increases by +4. Keep speed, saves, skills, and base attacks. Add two slams if it had none. If armed, use the weapon as the primary attack and a slam as secondary. Slam base damage from Fine through Colossal: 1d2, 1d3, 1d4, 1d6, 1d8, 2d6, 2d8, 4d6, 4d8. Keep stronger original damage. Str +4, no Con. Add Toughness and increase CR by 3. Aura of Death and Zombify use DC 10 + half HD + Cha modifier.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed sample gives a single sling attack as the alternative to two slams. The general template allows a weapon attack with a secondary slam.

gm.title: Description
lines: A koala-sized predator that nests in trees and caves. It uses long claws to break through protective gear and hunt for meat.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Magic Resistance. The zorbo has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Natural Armor. Its AC depends on the material it stands on or climbs. Use AC 15 for wood or bone, 17 for earth or stone, and 19 for metal. Use AC 10 when it touches none of those materials.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Destructive Claws. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing damage. If the target is a creature with armor, a shield, or an item that magically improves its AC, it also makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, it chooses one eligible item it wears or carries. The AC that item provides drops by 1. This penalty is permanent and cumulative. The zorbo gains +1 AC until the start of its next turn. The item breaks if armor drops to AC 10 or if a shield or protective magic item drops to a +0 AC bonus.

gm.title: Encounter context
lines: In the wilderness, travelers spot 2d6 zorbos in wukka trees. The zorbos warn off approaching creatures and attack if threatened. Around a campsite, hungry zorbos descend from the trees and attack outright. Four lurk near Obo'laka's shrine in Omu. They investigate the noisy entrance doors and target lone creatures or stragglers.

gm.title: Description
lines: The Demon Queen of Fungi spreads spores that turn living creatures into servants and eventually into hosts for fungal growth. Her principal palace on Shedaklah consists of two dozen giant mushrooms linked by shelf-fungus bridges.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Poison. Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/Day). When Zuggtmoy fails a save, she can choose to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. She has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Pseudopod attacks.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) force damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Cast one listed spell as an action, using Charisma (spell save DC 22) and omitting material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Locate Animals or Plants.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Entangle, Plant Growth.
1/day each. Etherealness, Teleport.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Infestation Spores (3/Day). Create a 20-ft.-radius spherical cloud centered on Zuggtmoy for 1 minute. Any creature inside when it appears or entering afterward makes a DC 19 Constitution save. Success grants immunity to these spores for 24 hours. Failure causes the spores of Zuggtmoy disease until cured or the creature dies. While infected, the creature cannot be reinfected and repeats the save at the end of every 24 hours. A success ends the infection. After three failed repeat saves, fungal growth kills the host and reanimates it as a spore servant if that creature can become one.
Mind Control Spores (Recharge 5–6). Create a 20-ft.-radius spherical cloud centered on Zuggtmoy for 1 minute. Humanoids and Beasts inside when it appears or entering afterward make a DC 19 Wisdom save. Success grants immunity to those spores for 24 hours. Failure causes the influence of Zuggtmoy disease for 24 hours. During that time the creature is charmed by Zuggtmoy and cannot be reinfected by these spores.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Protective Thrall. When an attack roll hits Zuggtmoy, redirect that hit to one creature within 10 ft. of her that is charmed by her.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Zuggtmoy has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn, spending the listed action cost. Spent legendary actions return at the start of the creature's turn. A creature cannot use these actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using them.
Attack (1 Action). Make one Pseudopod attack.
Exert Will (1 Action). Choose one visible creature charmed by Zuggtmoy. It uses its reaction if available, either to move up to its speed as directed or make one weapon attack against a target she designates.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
Zuggtmoy can choose one of the following options at initiative count 20, losing ties. An option cannot be used in consecutive rounds.
Rally Plants. Up to four friendly Plant creatures Zuggtmoy can see can spend their reactions to move up to their speed and make one weapon attack.
Summon Fungi. Four gas spores or violet fungi appear in unoccupied spaces Zuggtmoy chooses in her lair and vanish after 1 hour.
Unleash Spores. Use Infestation Spores or Mind Control Spores, centering the cloud on a mushroom or other fungus in the lair instead of Zuggtmoy.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects around Zuggtmoy's lair.
Corrupted Nature. Within 6 miles, Wisdom (Medicine) and Wisdom (Survival) checks have disadvantage.
Fungal Infestation. Within 6 miles, molds and fungi grow even on surfaces where they would not normally take hold.
Mutating Vegetation. Within 1 mile, parasitic fungi slowly alter the vegetation they infest.
After Zuggtmoy dies, the effects fade over 1d10 days.

lines:

Magic Resistance. She has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Pseudopod attacks.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.
Infestation Spores (3/day). A spore cloud fills a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on Zuggtmoy and lasts 1 minute. Each flesh-and-blood creature inside when it appears or that enters it later makes a DC 19 Constitution save. A success grants immunity to infection by these spores for 24 hours. On a failure, the target contracts the spores of Zuggtmoy, rolls on her madness table, and cannot be reinfected while the disease lasts. The madness lasts until the target is cured or dies. The target repeats the save after every 24 hours. A success ends the infection. Each failed repeat save advances the fungal takeover. After three failed repeat saves, the target dies and reanimates as a spore servant if eligible under the Monster Manual's Myconids entry.
Mind Control Spores (Recharge 5–6). A spore cloud fills a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on Zuggtmoy and lasts 1 minute. Each humanoid or beast inside when it appears or that enters it later makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. A success grants immunity to infection by these spores for 24 hours. On a failure the target contracts the influence of Zuggtmoy for 24 hours. While infected, it is charmed by her and cannot be reinfected by the same spores.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Protective Thrall. When an attack hits Zuggtmoy, one creature she has charmed within 5 ft. of her must use its reaction to take the hit in her place.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:

Attack (1 action). Make one Pseudopod attack.
Exert Will (1 action). One creature charmed by Zuggtmoy that she can see must use its reaction to move up to its speed as she directs or make one weapon attack against a target she picks.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing initiative ties, choose one option. Zuggtmoy cannot repeat the same option in consecutive rounds.
Spawn Fungi. Four gas spores or violet fungi appear in unoccupied spaces she chooses within the lair and vanish after 1 hour.
Command Plants. Up to four friendly plant creatures Zuggtmoy can see can use their reactions to move up to their speed and make one weapon attack each.
Fungal Source. Use Infestation Spores or Mind Control Spores, centered on a mushroom or other fungus within the lair.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects around the lair.
Mold and fungi take hold on surfaces within 6 miles, even if the surface would normally resist their growth.
Parasitic fungi infest and gradually deform plants within 1 mile.
A humanoid that spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure it rolls on the Madness of Zuggtmoy table. A success grants 24 hours of immunity to this effect.
The effects fade over 1d10 days after Zuggtmoy dies.

gm.title: Madness of Zuggtmoy
lines:
Roll d100 when a creature goes mad in the lair or in Zuggtmoy's line of sight. The resulting flaw lasts until cured, subject to the duration in Infestation Spores when applicable.
01–20. Sees visions nobody else can see.
21–40. Periodically goes still and stares into the distance.
41–60. Believes an altered version of events even when the evidence contradicts it.
61–80. Feels their thoughts sharpen and slip away without warning.
81–100. Continually scratches at fungal infections nobody else can see.
